entries.subject: english2
entries.title: revolt
entries.text:
## revolt

**音标**：/rɪˈvəʊlt/

**释义**：v./n. 反抗；起义；v./n. 反抗；造反；v. 反抗,反叛,违抗；n. 反抗,反叛,叛乱

**搭配**
- revolt against：反抗
- in revolt：叛乱,反叛

**例句**：The peasants' revolt was quickly suppressed, but it exposed deep discontent with the government's new land policy.

农民起义很快被镇压，但它暴露出民众对政府新土地政策的深深不满。

**提示**：助记:re(against反)+volt(roll转)→反转→反抗,叛乱;辨析:revolt类似revolution,指大规模有组织且用暴力的反抗;rebel,rebellion仅指局部的反抗行为

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: revolution
entries.text:
## revolution

**音标**：/ˌrevəˈluːʃn/

**释义**：n. 革命；n. 旋转,转数；n. 旋转；革命；变革

**例句**：The Industrial Revolution transformed Britain within a few generations.

工业革命在几代人之内改变了英国。

**提示**：n.变革；革命；旋转；旋转一 周；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: revolutionary
entries.text:
## revolutionary

**音标**：/ˌrevəˈluːʃənəri/

**释义**：n. 革命者；adj. 革命的,革新的；adj. 革命性的；革命的

**例句**：The new treatment is regarded as revolutionary in the fight against cancer.

这种新疗法被视为抗癌斗争中的革命性突破。

**提示**：助记:revolution(革命)+ary(名词后缀表示人)→革命者；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: revolve
entries.text:
## revolve

**音标**：/rɪˈvɒlv/

**释义**：vi. 旋转；环绕；vt. (使)旋转；v. 转动，旋转；环绕

**搭配**
- revolve around...：围绕……旋转；以……为中心

**例句**：In the first year or so of Web business, most of the action has revolved around efforts to tap the consumer market.

在网络交易的第一年左右，大部分活动都是围绕着努力开发消费者市场而进行的。

**提示**：rotate 的近义词；助记:re(again再)+volve(roll卷)→旋转；v.旋转；围绕；以……为中心；adj.旋转的；re（表示重复）+volv（旋转）+e→重复地旋转→旋转；环绕；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: reward
entries.text:
## reward

**音标**：/rɪ'wɔːd/

**释义**：n. 奖励；回报；vt. 奖励；奖赏；n. 报答；奖赏；vt. 奖赏；报答；n. [C] 报答；奖赏；vt. 酬谢；奖励

**搭配**
- as a reward for：作为对……的回报
- reward sb. with sth.：以某物奖励某人
- a reward for hard work：对辛勤工作的回报
- be rewarded with sth：获得某物作为回报

**例句**：Scientists need journals in which to publish their research, so they will supply the articles without monetary reward.

科学家需要一些期刊来发表他们的研究成果，因此他们会无偿提供文章。

**提示**：[族] rewarding adj. 有益的；值得做的；reward（报答）vs award（颁发；奖项）；award指正式或官方颁布授予,可指法庭裁决,后接双宾语;reward指做好事得回报,不接双宾语,以何为报酬须加with；n.奖励，回报；报偿，报 应 v.酬谢，奖赏；奖励；re(再)+ward(联想成word“

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rewarding
entries.text:
## rewarding

**音标**：/rɪˈwɔːdɪŋ/

**释义**：adj. 有益的；值得做的；令人满意的

**例句**：Volunteering at the shelter proved more rewarding than she had expected, teaching her patience and quiet humility.

在收容所做志愿服务比她预想的更有收获，教会了她耐心与谦逊。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rewilding
entries.text:
## rewilding

**音标**：/ˌriː'waɪldɪŋ/

**释义**：n. [U] (大片土地的)野化

**例句**：Rewilding of former farmland has allowed rare birds, beavers and even wolves to return to the region.

对昔日农田实行野化，使珍稀鸟类、河狸乃至狼得以重返该地区。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rhetoric
entries.text:
## rhetoric

**音标**：/ˈretərɪk/

**释义**：n. [U] 华而不实的言语；花言巧语；n. [U] 修辞艺术；n. 华而不实的言语,花言巧语；n. 修辞技巧,修辞(学)

**搭配**
- the win-win rhetoric：双赢的言辞
- the rhetoric of reform：关于改革的空谈
- political rhetoric：政治修辞艺术

**例句**：Voters have grown tired of the president's empty rhetoric and now expect concrete action on unemployment.

选民已厌倦了总统空洞的言辞，如今期待在失业问题上采取切实行动。

**提示**：[族] rhetorical a. 辞藻华丽的 [族] rhetorically ad. 善用言辞地；同义:eloquence,oratory

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rhythm
entries.text:
## rhythm

**音标**：/ˈrɪðəm/

**释义**：n. 节奏；韵律；n. 节律；规律；n. [U, C] 规律；规则变化；n. [U,C] 节奏；韵律；n. [C][U] 节奏；韵律；n. 节奏,韵律

**搭配**
- the rhythm of the seasons：四季的更替规律
- the rhythm of modern life：现代生活的规律
- music with a fast rhythm：节奏快的音乐
- the rhythm of the music：音乐的节奏

**例句**：Doctors point out that shift work can disturb the natural rhythm of the body and cause long-term health problems.

医生指出，轮班工作会扰乱人体的自然节律，并引发长期健康问题。

**提示**：[族] rhythmic adj. 有节奏的；本身为词根，意为“节奏”；[族] rhythmic a. 有节奏的；rhythmically ad. 有节奏地

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rib
entries.text:
## rib

**音标**：/rɪb/

**释义**：n. 肋骨,肋状物;罗纹；v. 嘲笑,逗弄

**例句**：The scan revealed a cracked rib, but the doctor said the injury would heal naturally within weeks.

扫描显示有一根肋骨骨裂，但医生说几周内伤处会自然愈合。

**提示**：助记:rid(去掉)布料上的rib(罗纹)

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: ribbon
entries.text:
## ribbon

**音标**：/'rɪbən/

**释义**：n. 缎带,丝带,带,带状物

**例句**：The mayor cut the ribbon, and hundreds of visitors streamed into the newly opened science centre.

市长剪彩后，数百名参观者涌入了新开放的科学中心。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rice
entries.text:
## rice

**音标**：/rais/

**释义**：n. [U] 稻；米饭

**例句**：In many Asian countries, rice remains the most important crop, both as a staple food and as a source of rural income.

在许多亚洲国家，稻米仍然是最重要的作物，既是主食，也是农村收入的来源。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rich
entries.text:
## rich

**音标**：/rɪtʃ/

**释义**：adj. 富有的；富裕的；adj. 丰富的；富含……的；adj. 肥沃的；丰产的；a. 富有的；丰富的；a. 富有的；富饶的；丰富多彩的；油腻的；肥沃的；adj. 富的,有钱的

**搭配**
- be rich in：富含……
- rich harvest：丰收
- a rich and hotly-contested market：饱和的、竞争激烈的市场

**例句**：The region is rich in minerals, which attracts mining companies from abroad.

该地区矿产丰富，吸引了国外的矿业公司。

**提示**：[族] enrich vt. 使富裕；充实（链接P348）；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: richly
entries.text:
## richly

**音标**：/'rɪtʃlɪ/

**释义**：ad. 富丽堂皇地；完全地；大方地

**例句**：The palace's richly decorated halls reflect the wealth of the merchants who once traded in this port.

宫殿里装饰华丽的厅堂折射出曾在这个港口经商的商人们的财富。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: richness
entries.text:
## richness

**音标**：/'rɪtʃnəs/

**释义**：n. 丰富;富裕;浓烈；n. 丰富

**例句**：The richness of the valley's soil explains why the region has been farmed continuously for over two thousand years.

山谷土壤的肥沃解释了该地区为何两千多年来一直被持续耕种。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rid
entries.text:
## rid

**音标**：/rɪd/

**释义**：vt. 使摆脱；使去掉；vt.(rid/ridded,rid/ridded) (of)使摆脱,使去掉；v. 摆脱；清除

**搭配**
- get rid of：摆脱；去除
- rid sb. of sth.：使某人摆脱某物
- rid...of...：使……摆脱……
- rid oneself of sth：使自己摆脱某物

**例句**：The city has spent millions trying to rid itself of traffic congestion.

这座城市已花费数百万美元试图摆脱交通拥堵。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: riddle
entries.text:
## riddle

**音标**：/ˈrɪdl/

**释义**：n. 谜；谜语；n. 谜,谜语

**例句**：Scientists are still trying to solve the riddle of how the ancient builders moved such massive stones without modern machinery.

科学家们仍在试图解开古代建造者如何在没有现代机械的情况下搬运如此巨大石块的谜团。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: ride
entries.text:
## ride

**音标**：/raɪd/

**释义**：vt.&vi. 骑；乘；n. 骑；乘车旅行；v. 骑；乘；n. 骑；乘车兜风

**搭配**
- ride a bike：骑自行车
- give sb. a ride：让某人搭车

**例句**：The new high-speed rail line has cut the ride between the two cities from five hours to less than two.

新高铁线路将两座城市之间的车程从五小时缩短到不到两小时。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: ridge
entries.text:
## ridge

**音标**：/rɪdʒ/

**释义**：n. 岭,山脉；n. 屋脊;鼻梁

**例句**：The path follows the ridge of the hill, giving walkers a sweeping view of the valley below.

这条小路沿山脊延伸，让步行者尽览下方山谷的开阔景色。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: ridiculous
entries.text:
## ridiculous

**音标**：/rɪˈdɪkjələs/

**释义**：adj. 荒谬的；可笑的；a. 荒谬的；可笑的；adj. 可笑的,荒唐的,荒谬的；adj. 可笑的，荒谬的

**搭配**
- ridiculous behavior：荒谬的行为

**例句**：I look ridiculous in this hat.

我戴这顶帽子看上去很可笑。

**提示**：[族] ridicule vt.&n. 嘲笑；奚落；助记:ridicule(讥笑)+ous(形容词后缀)→可笑的

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rifle
entries.text:
## rifle

**音标**：/'raɪfl/

**释义**：n. 步枪；vt. 迅速翻找

**例句**：The museum displays rifles used by soldiers during the civil war, alongside letters and photographs from that period.

博物馆展出了内战期间士兵使用过的步枪，旁边还陈列着那个时期的书信和照片。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rig
entries.text:
## rig

**音标**：/rɪɡ/

**释义**：刚硬

**例句**：In freezing weather the plastic becomes rigid, so the pipe must be handled carefully to avoid cracking.

在严寒天气里塑料会变得僵硬，因此搬运管道时必须小心，以免开裂。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: right
entries.text:
## right

**音标**：/raɪt/

**释义**：adj. 正确的；对的；adj. 右边的；右派的；adv. 正好；恰好；n. 权利；a. 正确的；对的；a. 正确的；恰当的；右边的

**搭配**
- have the right to do sth.：有权做某事
- right away：立刻
- have the right to do：有权做某事

**例句**：Citizens have a legal right to examine government records, although officials may delay disclosure on security grounds.

公民享有查阅政府档案的合法权利，尽管官员可以以安全为由推迟公开。

**提示**：[族] rightly adv. 正确地；[族] righteous adj. 正当的

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: righteous
entries.text:
## righteous

**音标**：/'raɪtʃəs/

**释义**：adj. 公正的,正直的,正当的

**例句**：He presented himself as a righteous defender of ordinary taxpayers, though his own finances were hardly spotless.

他把自己标榜为普通纳税人的正义捍卫者，尽管他自己的财务并不干净。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rightfully
entries.text:
## rightfully

**音标**：/ˈraɪtfəli/

**释义**：adv. 正当地；正直地

**例句**：According to documents in the county archive, the land rightfully belongs to the local farming community.

根据县档案馆藏的文件，这片土地理应属于当地农耕社区。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rightly
entries.text:
## rightly

**音标**：/'raɪtlɪ/

**释义**：ad. 恰当地；正确地；精确地；理由充分地

**例句**：Critics rightly observed that the report praised the scheme while ignoring the heavy cost of carrying it out.

批评者恰当地指出，该报告对计划大加赞扬，却无视执行所需的高昂成本。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rigid
entries.text:
## rigid

**音标**：/'rɪdʒɪd/

**释义**：a. 严格死板的，僵化的；a. 固执的；一成不变的；a. 坚硬的；僵直的；a. 僵硬的；严格的；adj. 刚性的,坚硬的；adj. 严格的,苛严的

**搭配**
- a rigid moral code：严格的道德准则
- the rigid social ladder：严格的社会阶梯
- rigid management：僵化的管理
- shake sb. rigid：使目瞪口呆,使惊讶

**例句**：Today, we are much more rigid about immigrants.

今天，我们对移民的态度要严格得多。

**提示**：[族]rigidly 严格地；[近]inflexible 顽固的；僵化的；反义flexible adj.柔韧的;灵活的；adj.严格死板的，僵化的；顽固 的；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rigidly
entries.text:
## rigidly

**音标**：/ˈrɪdʒɪdli/

**释义**：ad. 严格地

**例句**：The old factory clung rigidly to fixed routines, leaving workers little freedom to adjust how they worked.

这家老工厂死守一成不变的固定流程，工人几乎没有调整工作方式的自由。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rigorous
entries.text:
## rigorous

**音标**：/'rɪgərəs/

**释义**：adj. 严格（严密）的；严厉的；adj. 严格的,严厉的；adj. 严酷的,严峻的；adj. 严格的，严厉的；谨慎的；细致的；彻底的；adj. 严格的；缜密的

**例句**：Schooling and rigorous book learning put unnatural restraints on children.

学校教育和严格的课本学习对孩子们施加了不自然的限制。

**提示**：派生rigorousness n.严厉;严峻；发音类似“若哥惹事”→哥哥惹事妈妈会严厉处罚→严厉的。；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rim
entries.text:
## rim

**音标**：/rɪm/

**释义**：n. 边缘；（圆形物的）边；v. 给…镶边；n. (圆物的)边,轮缘;边界

**例句**：Small fishing villages cling to the rim of the lake, their wooden houses standing on poles above the water.

小渔村依偎在湖缘，木屋靠高出水面的木桩支撑。

**提示**：辨析:rim指曲线形或圆形的边(如碗边);edge指明显的终端线,常含锋利之意

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: ring
entries.text:
## ring

**音标**：/rɪŋ/

**释义**：n. 戒指；环；n. 铃声；钟声；vt.&vi. 打电话；（使）响；n. 环；圈；v. （钟）鸣响；n. [C] 戒指；环；铃声

**搭配**
- ring back：回电话
- ring off：挂断电话

**例句**：She glanced at the gold ring on her finger, a gift from her grandmother on her eighteenth birthday.

她瞥了一眼手指上的金戒指，那是她十八岁生日时祖母送的礼物。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: riot
entries.text:
## riot

**音标**：/ˈraɪət/

**释义**：n. 暴乱；骚乱；vi. 参加暴乱；聚众闹事；n. 暴乱；喧嚣；n. 暴（骚）乱；极度丰富；vi. 聚众闹事；vi. 骚乱,放纵,挥霍

**搭配**
- run riot：撒野；失去控制
- riot of sth.：充分的表现或展示

**例句**：The city imposed a night-time curfew after riots broke out in several districts following the controversial court decision.

在有争议的法院裁决后，多个街区爆发骚乱，该市实施了夜间宵禁。

**提示**：[族] rioter n. 暴徒；暴乱者；派生riotous adj.无秩序的,混乱的;riotously adv.极端地

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rip
entries.text:
## rip

**音标**：/rɪp/

**释义**：vt.&vi. 撕裂；撕开；n. 裂口；裂缝；vt. 扯破,撕裂；n. 裂口,裂缝

**搭配**
- rip...open：撕开……
- rip...off：撕掉……；敲诈
- rip sth. open：拉(撕)开某物
- rip sth. off：撕掉某物

**例句**：Strong winds ripped the roof off the old warehouse and scattered debris across the neighbouring streets.

强风掀掉了旧仓库的屋顶，把碎片刮得散落在邻近的街道上。

**提示**：[近] tear vt. 撕

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: ripe
entries.text:
## ripe

**音标**：/raɪp/

**释义**：adj. 成熟的,时机成熟的；adj. 做好充分准备的

**搭配**
- be ripe for...：准备成熟的

**例句**：With public support at a record high and delay proving costly, the moment is ripe for reform.

公众支持达到历史新高，而拖延的代价又与日俱增，改革的时机已然成熟。

**提示**：派生ripen v.(使)成熟

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rise
entries.text:
## rise

**音标**：/raɪz/

**释义**：vi. 上升；升起；vi. 增加；提高；n. 上升；增加；n. [C] （数量或水平的）增加；加薪；vi. 上升；提高；v. (rose,risen)升起,上升

**搭配**
- give rise to：引起；导致
- rise to one's feet：站起来
- a rise in prices：物价上涨
- on the rise：在增长

**例句**：Everybody loves a fat pay rise.

人人都喜欢大幅加薪。

**提示**：[辨] rise-rose-risen 不及物；[近] arise vi. 产生（链接P346）；辨析：不及物动词，过去式rose，过去分词risen，含义为“增加，提高，上升”；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: risk
entries.text:
## risk

**音标**：/rɪsk/

**释义**：n. 危险；风险；vt. 冒……的风险；n. 风险；危险；vt. 冒……的危险；n. [C,U] 危险；风险；vt. 冒……的风险（或危险）

**搭配**
- at the risk of：冒……的风险
- take/run the risk of doing：冒险做……
- at risk：处境危险
- run/take the risk of doing：冒险做某事

**例句**：When education becomes one-size-fits-all, it risks overlooking a nation's diversity of gifts.

当教育变得一刀切的时候，就会存在忽视一个国家人才多样化的风险。

**提示**：[族] risky adj. 危险的；冒险的；另：take a risk冒险；reduce the risk of降低…的风险；at risk处境危险、受到威胁；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: riskily
entries.text:
## riskily

**音标**：/'rɪskɪli/

**释义**：adv. 冒险地

**例句**：The young firm riskily committed almost its entire capital to a single untested technology.

这家年轻公司孤注一掷，把几乎全部资金押在一项未经检验的技术上。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: risky
entries.text:
## risky

**音标**：/'rɪski/

**释义**：adj. 危险的；冒险的；adj. 有危险或风险的

**例句**：Analysts described the company's decision to enter the electric vehicle market as risky but potentially very profitable.

分析人士称，该公司进军电动汽车市场的决定有风险，但潜在利润可能十分可观。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: ritual
entries.text:
## ritual

**音标**：/ˈrɪtʃuəl/

**释义**：n. 惯例；n. 程序；（尤指）宗教仪式；a. 仪式上的；例行的；宗教仪式；adj. 典礼的,(宗教)仪式的;通常的,习惯的；n. 典礼,(宗教)仪式,礼节

**搭配**
- an annual ritual：年度惯例
- morning beauty rituals：早晨美容程序
- the usual ritual apology：例行公事式的道歉
- develop a daily ritual：养成日常习惯

**例句**：Drinking tea in the afternoon is a daily ritual in many British homes.

下午喝茶是许多英国家庭的日常惯例。

**提示**：本身为词根，意为“宗教仪式”。近义：ceremony n. 仪式。；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: ritualistic
entries.text:
## ritualistic

**音标**：/ˌrɪtʃuəˈlɪstɪk/

**释义**：a. 仪式的；例行公事的

**例句**：Critics dismissed the annual award ceremony as ritualistic, arguing that it no longer carried any real meaning.

批评者贬斥年度颁奖典礼流于形式，认为它已不再具有任何实际意义。

**提示**：ritual 的词族拓展词。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: riv
entries.text:
## riv

**音标**：/rɪv/

**释义**：河

**例句**：Many of the world's great cities grew up beside a river, which supplied fresh water and cheap transport.

世界上许多大城市都依河而建，河流提供了淡水和廉价的运输条件。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rival
entries.text:
## rival

**音标**：/'raɪvl/

**释义**：n. [C]竞争对手；vt. 与……相匹敌；n. 竞争者；对手；adj. 竞争的；n. [C] 竞争者；对手；n. 竞争者，对手

**搭配**
- rival sb./sth. for/in sth.：在某方面与……竞争
- defeat one's rival：击败对手
- without rival：无可匹敌
- rival sb in sth：在某事上与某人匹敌

**例句**：Court, school, organizations of amateurs, and the traveling actors were all rivals in supplying a widespread desire for dramatic entertainment.

宫廷、学校、业余组织和巡演艺人都在竞相满足人们对戏剧娱乐的普遍需求。

**提示**：[近] competitor n. 竞争者；n.竞争对手，敌手；对手(rival)马上就要到达(arrival)比赛现场；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rivalry
entries.text:
## rivalry

**音标**：/ˈraɪvlri/

**释义**：n. 竞争；对抗；n. 竞争

**例句**：The rivalry between the two technology firms has driven prices down and accelerated the pace of innovation.

两家科技公司之间的竞争压低了价格，并加快了创新步伐。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: river
entries.text:
## river

**音标**：/ˈrɪvə(r)/

**释义**：n. 河；江；n. [C] 河，江

**例句**：The city grew wealthy because it controlled trade along the river.

这座城市因控制沿河贸易而变得富裕。

**提示**：n.河，江

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: riverboat
entries.text:
## riverboat

**音标**：/'rɪvəbəʊt/

**释义**：n. [C] 内河船；江轮

**例句**：A lovingly restored riverboat now carries tourists along the waterway, offering a glimpse of travel in the past.

一艘精心修复的内河船如今载着游客航行于这条水道，让人得以一窥昔日的旅行光景。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: road
entries.text:
## road

**音标**：/rəʊd/

**释义**：n. 路；公路；道路；n. 路线；途径；n. 路；道路；n. 途径；n. [C] 路，道路；途径

**搭配**
- on the road：在旅途中
- the road to success：成功之路
- on the road to：在……的过程中

**例句**：Engineers warned that the mountain road would remain closed until crews cleared the rocks fallen during the storm.

工程师们警告，在工作人员清除暴风雨中滚落的岩石之前，山路将保持封闭。

**提示**：[近] path n. 小路；路径；[近] route n. 路线

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: roadblock
entries.text:
## roadblock

**音标**：/'rəʊdblɒk/

**释义**：n. [C] 路障；障碍；n. 障碍物；路障

**例句**：Protesters set up a roadblock on the main highway, forcing hundreds of commuters to find other routes into the city.

抗议者在主干公路上设置路障，迫使数百名通勤者另寻进城路线。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: roadlock
entries.text:
## roadlock

**音标**：/ˈrəʊdlɒk/

**例句**：A fallen tree formed a roadlock across the narrow lane, and supplies could not reach the village for days.

一棵倒下的树横在窄路上形成路障，物资数日无法送达村庄。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: roar
entries.text:
## roar

**音标**：/rɔː/

**释义**：vi. 咆哮；怒吼；vi. 大笑；（引擎）轰鸣；n. 咆哮；轰鸣；v. 吼叫；怒号；n. 吼声；咆哮；v. 吼叫,怒吼,大声喊

**搭配**
- roar with laughter：放声大笑

**例句**：We could hear the roar of the engines clearly as the aircraft accelerated along the runway.

飞机沿跑道加速时，我们能清楚地听到引擎的轰鸣声。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: roast
entries.text:
## roast

**音标**：/rəust/

**释义**：v. 烤，炙；adj. 烤过的；v. 烤,炙,烘

**例句**：My grandmother taught me to roast the chicken slowly so that the meat stays tender and the skin turns golden.

祖母教我慢慢烤鸡，这样肉质鲜嫩，鸡皮金黄。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rob
entries.text:
## rob

**音标**：/rɒb/

**释义**：vt. 抢劫；盗取；vt. (of)抢劫,盗取；vt. 非法剥夺

**搭配**
- rob sb of sth：抢夺某人某物

**例句**：The thieves managed to rob the jewellery store in broad daylight before escaping through the crowded market.

窃贼光天化日之下抢了珠宝店，然后穿过拥挤的市场逃走了。

**提示**：辨析:rob对象是人,steal对象是物;rob用rob sb. of sth.,steal用steal sth. from sb.

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: robe
entries.text:
## robe

**音标**：/rəʊb/

**释义**：n. 长袍,长衣(c)

**例句**：The judge put on the black robe and entered the courtroom as the public gallery fell silent.

法官穿上黑色法袍走进法庭，旁听席随即安静下来。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: robot
entries.text:
## robot

**音标**：/ˈrəʊbɒt/

**释义**：n. 机器人

**搭配**
- a robot vacuum：扫地机器人

**例句**：Factories are increasingly replacing human workers with robots, raising concerns about job losses among low-skilled labour.

工厂正日益用机器人取代人工，引发了人们对低技能劳动者失业的担忧。

**提示**：[族] robotics n. 机器人学；[族] robotic adj. 机器人的

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: robotics
entries.text:
## robotics

**音标**：/rəʊ'bɒtɪks/

**释义**：n. (用作单数)机器人学,机器人技术

**例句**：Advances in robotics have enabled factories to automate tasks once considered too delicate for any machine.

机器人技术的进步使工厂得以将曾被认为任何机器都难以胜任的精细任务自动化。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: robust
entries.text:
## robust

**音标**：/rəʊˈbʌst/

**释义**：adj. 有活力的;强健的；adj. 粗野的,粗鲁的；adj. (指酒)浓烈的,醇厚的；adj. 强大的；强健的；坚决的；粗野的

**搭配**
- an even more robust defense：更强大的防御

**例句**：The economy remains robust despite uncertainty in global markets.

尽管全球市场存在不确定性，经济依然强劲。

**提示**：派生robustly adv.有活力地;robustness n.强健、粗野；adj.强健的；稳固的；结实的；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rock
entries.text:
## rock

**音标**：/rɒk/

**释义**：n. 岩石；石头；n. 摇滚乐；vt.&vi. 摇动；摇晃；n. 岩石；v. 摇动；n. [C] 岩石；摇滚乐

**搭配**
- rock the boat：捣乱；惹麻烦
- rock and roll：摇滚乐

**例句**：The climbers paused on a narrow ledge of rock, waiting for the wind to drop before continuing their ascent.

登山者在一处狭窄的岩石壁架上停留，等风力减弱后再继续攀登。

**提示**：[族] rocky adj. 岩石的；困难的；辨析:rock剧烈摇动;swing上端固定下端摇;sway下端固定上端摇

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rocket
entries.text:
## rocket

**音标**：/ˈrɒkɪt/

**释义**：n. 火箭；v. 猛涨；n. [C] 火箭；vi. 猛涨；飞速移动；n. 火箭(c)

**例句**：After the product was recommended by a popular blogger, online sales rocketed within a single week.

该产品经一位知名博主推荐后，网上销量在一周之内猛涨。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rod
entries.text:
## rod

**音标**：/rɒd/

**释义**：n. 杆,棒

**搭配**
- have a rod in pickle for someone：准备好惩罚某人
- make a rod for one's own back：自找麻烦

**例句**：A thin steel rod supports the bookshelf, preventing it from bowing under the weight of heavy volumes.

一根细钢杆支撑着书架，防止它在厚重书籍的重压下弯曲。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rogue
entries.text:
## rogue

**音标**：/rəʊɡ/

**释义**：n. 流氓,无赖;捣蛋鬼；adj. 离群的;行为失常的;暴戾的

**例句**：A rogue trader's hidden losses nearly bankrupted the bank, exposing serious weaknesses in its internal controls.

一名行事乖张的交易员隐瞒亏损，几乎令该银行破产，暴露出其内部控制的严重漏洞。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rol
entries.text:
## rol

**音标**：/rəʊl/

**释义**：圆

**例句**：As the heavy barrel began to roll down the ramp, the workers scrambled to clear the path.

沉重的圆桶开始沿坡道滚下时，工人们连忙清理通道避让。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: role
entries.text:
## role

**音标**：/rəʊl/

**释义**：n. 角色；任务；n. 作用；职能；n. 角色；作用；n. [C] 角色；作用；n. [C] 作用；角色

**搭配**
- play a role in：在……中起作用
- play the role of：扮演……的角色
- a leading role：主角

**例句**：Teachers play a crucial role in shaping how students respond to failure and unexpected setbacks.

教师在塑造学生应对失败和意外挫折的态度方面发挥着关键作用。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: roll
entries.text:
## roll

**音标**：/rəʊl/

**释义**：v. 滚动；卷；n. 卷；名册；vt.&vi. （使）翻滚，滚动；（使）翻身，翻转；n. 卷；v. 滚动,滚落；v. 卷,绕;(使)摇晃

**搭配**
- roll up：卷起(拢)
- roll in：卷起来

**例句**：Throughout the stormy afternoon, we watched the great waves roll in from the Atlantic, one after another.

整个风雨交加的下午，我们看着巨浪一个接一个地从大西洋滚滚涌来。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: roma
entries.text:
## roma

**音标**：/ˈrəʊmə/

**释义**：罗马

**例句**：Ancient Rome built roads and aqueducts whose remains can still be traced across much of Europe today.

古罗马修建的道路和渡槽的遗迹，至今仍能在欧洲大部分地区寻见。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: romance
entries.text:
## romance

**音标**：/rəʊˈmæns/

**释义**：n. 传奇,爱情故事

**例句**：The novel weaves a tender romance into a sharp analysis of social change in Victorian England.

这部小说把一段温婉的爱情故事融入对维多利亚时代英国社会变革的敏锐剖析之中。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: romantic
entries.text:
## romantic

**音标**：/rəʊˈmæntɪk/

**释义**：adj. 浪漫的；爱情的；adj. 不切实际的；a. 浪漫的；爱情的；a. 不切实际的；adj. 浪漫的,传奇式的；adj. 不切实际的,好幻想的

**搭配**
- a romantic novel：爱情小说
- romantic ideas：不切实际的想法

**例句**：The novel paints a romantic picture of country life, although farming in reality involves constant hard work and uncertainty.

这部小说描绘了浪漫的乡村生活图景，尽管现实中的农业意味着持续的辛劳和不确定性。

**提示**：[族] romance n. 浪漫史；传奇；助记:音"罗曼蒂克"

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: roof
entries.text:
## roof

**音标**：/ruːf/

**释义**：n. 屋顶；顶部；n. [C] 屋顶；顶部；n. [C] 屋顶；顶部；车顶；vt. 给……盖顶；n. 屋顶,顶

**搭配**
- under one roof：在同一屋檐下
- no roof over one's head：无家可归

**例句**：Rain poured through the broken roof, damaging most of the equipment stored in the abandoned factory.

雨水从破损的屋顶倾泻而入，损坏了废弃工厂里存放的大部分设备。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: room
entries.text:
## room

**音标**：/ruːm/

**释义**：n. 房间；n. 空间；余地；n. [C] 房间；[U] 空间；可能性；机会

**搭配**
- make room for：给……腾出空间

**例句**：There is little room for negotiation, since the contract clearly states the deadline and the penalties for delay.

几乎没有商量的余地，因为合同明确规定了最后期限和延误罚则。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: root
entries.text:
## root

**音标**：/ruːt/

**释义**：n. 根；根茎；n. 根源；起因；vi. （使）生根；n. 根；根源；v. （使）生根；n. [C] 根；根源

**搭配**
- the root cause：根本原因
- be rooted in：植根于
- root in：起源于

**例句**：The tree's roots were damaged when the road was widened.

道路拓宽时，这棵树的根被损坏了。

**提示**：n.根，根茎;根源，起因 v.扎根于；根源在于

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rope
entries.text:
## rope

**音标**：/rəʊp/

**释义**：n. 绳；索；n. 绳,索

**搭配**
- give someone rope：任其自由行动

**例句**：The rescuers fixed a rope around the rocks and lowered supplies to the climbers trapped on the cliff face.

救援人员在岩石上固定绳索，把物资吊给被困在悬崖上的登山者。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rose
entries.text:
## rose

**音标**：/rəʊz/

**释义**：n. 玫瑰；n. [C] 玫瑰花；n. 玫瑰,蔷薇

**例句**：She pressed a dried rose between the pages of her diary, a reminder of the summer she spent in Paris.

她把一朵干玫瑰夹进日记书页，纪念她在巴黎度过的那个夏天。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rosy
entries.text:
## rosy

**音标**：/'rəʊzi/

**释义**：adj. 粉红色的,红润的;美好的,乐观的

**例句**：Independent economists paint a far less rosy picture of next year's growth than the government does.

独立经济学家对来年增长的描绘远没有政府那么乐观。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rot
entries.text:
## rot

**音标**：/rɒt/

**释义**：v. 腐烂；腐败；n. 腐烂；v./n. 腐烂；腐败；vt.&vi. （使）腐烂，腐败；v. 腐烂,腐朽,腐化；v. 逐渐衰败

**搭配**
- rot away：烂掉

**例句**：The wood must not get damp as rot can quickly result.

木头不能受潮，否则很快就会烂掉。

**提示**：派生：rotten

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rotate
entries.text:
## rotate

**音标**：/rəʊˈteɪt/

**释义**：v. （使）旋转；（使）转动；vi. 轮值；轮换；vt.&vi. （使）旋转，转动；vt.&vi. （人员）轮换，轮值；vt. (使)旋转；v.（使）旋转，转动；轮值

**搭配**
- rotate around...：绕……旋转
- rotate crops：轮作农作物
- rotate the wheel：转动方向盘
- rotate the night shift：轮流值夜班

**例句**：The EU presidency rotates among the members.

欧盟主席一职由其成员国轮流担任。

**提示**：族：rotation n. 旋转；轮作。近义：revolve v. 旋转；[记] rot（转）+-ate（动词后缀）。[族] rotation n. 旋转；转动。[近] spin（使）快速旋转；辨析：rotate 以自身内部轴为中心旋转；revolve 以他物为轴或点作为中心旋转；roll 指一个物体在另一物体表面上滚

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rotation
entries.text:
## rotation

**音标**：/rəʊˈteɪʃn/

**释义**：n. 旋转；轮作；n. 旋转，转动；轮换；交替；换班

**例句**：To keep the soil fertile, farmers plant different crops each year in a practice known as crop rotation.

为保持土壤肥沃，农民每年种植不同作物，这一做法被称为轮作。

**提示**：rotate 的派生词

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: rotten
entries.text:
## rotten

**音标**：/rʌt/

**释义**：n. 车辙,槽,凹痕;常规,老规矩

**例句**：After a decade in the same post, he felt trapped in a rut and began applying for new challenges.

在同一岗位干了十年之后，他感到自己陷入了墨守成规的窠臼，开始申请新的挑战。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: ruthless
entries.text:
## ruthless

**音标**：/'ruːθləs/

**释义**：adj. 无情的,残忍的,冷酷的；adj. 无情的

**搭配**
- ruthless advertising：无情的广告

**例句**：The report portrays the chief executive as a ruthless negotiator who rarely conceded anything during the merger talks.

报告把这位首席执行官描绘成冷酷无情的谈判者，在合并谈判中几乎不作让步。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: ry
entries.text:
## ry

**音标**：/ri/

**释义**：名词后缀

**例句**：Modern farms depend heavily on costly machinery, from milking equipment to satellite-guided harvesters.

现代农场严重依赖昂贵的机械设备，从挤奶设备到卫星导航收割机不一而足。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sack
entries.text:
## sack

**音标**：/sæk/

**释义**：n. 麻袋,纸袋,塑料袋;[the ~][口]开除,解雇；v. 开除,解雇

**搭配**
- get the sack：被开除

**例句**：The treasurer was given the sack after the accounts failed an independent audit for the third time.

账目第三次未通过独立审计后，这位财务主管被解雇了。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sacred
entries.text:
## sacred

**音标**：/ˈseɪkrɪd/

**释义**：a. 神圣的；宗教的；a. 神圣的；上帝的；adj. 神圣的；宗教的；adj. 神圣的；宗教(性)的,神圣不可侵犯的,庄严的；adj. 神圣的，庄严的；受尊重的

**搭配**
- sacred land：圣地
- be sacred to sb.：对某人来说是神圣的
- sacred cow：(贬义)貌似神圣不可冒犯的人或物

**例句**：Human life must always be sacred.

人的生命在任何时候都必须得到尊重。

**提示**：sacr(神圣)+-ed→神圣的；[反] secular 世俗的；[记] sacr（神圣的）+-ed（形容词后缀）。[族] sacredness n. 神圣。[近] holy a. 神圣的；同义:holy,divine;反义:secular 现世的,世俗的；发音类似“seek（寻找）red（红色）”→党组织在心中是神圣

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sacredness
entries.text:
## sacredness

**音标**：/ˈseɪkrɪdnəs/

**释义**：n. 神圣

**例句**：For the local community, the sacredness of the ancient grove forbids hunting or the felling of trees.

对当地社区而言，这片古圣林的神圣性禁止狩猎或砍伐树木。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sacrifice
entries.text:
## sacrifice

**音标**：/ˈsækrɪfaɪs/

**释义**：n. 牺牲；舍弃；vt. 牺牲；献出；n. 祭品；祭祀；n. [C,U] 牺牲；献祭；v. 牺牲；献出；n.&v. 牺牲；献祭

**搭配**
- sacrifice...for/to...：为……牺牲……
- make sacrifices：作出牺牲
- sacrifice A for B：为B牺牲A
- sacrifice ... for ...：为...牺牲...

**例句**：Her parents made great sacrifices to send her to university.

她的父母为送她上大学做出了巨大牺牲。

**提示**：sacr(神圣)+i+fic(做)+e→为神圣的目的做事→献祭→牺牲；[族]sacrificial a. 献祭的；sacr（神圣）+i+fice（做）→做神圣的事→献祭；sacri（神圣）+fic（做，制作）+e→做神圣的事→古时候祭祀是很神圣的事，都需要一些“献祭品”→祭品；牺牲。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sad
entries.text:
## sad

**音标**：/sæd/

**释义**：a. 悲哀的；令人难过的；a. 悲哀的；难过的；令人悲哀的；状况不佳的

**搭配**
- sad news：令人悲伤的消息

**例句**：It is sad that so many historic buildings were demolished before anyone recognized their cultural value.

令人难过的是，许多历史建筑在被拆除时无人认识到它们的文化价值。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: saddle
entries.text:
## saddle

**音标**：/'sædl/

**释义**：n. 鞍,马鞍,鞍状物(c)

**搭配**
- in the saddle：骑着马;(比喻)处于控制地位
- out of the saddle：落马;下台,被免职

**例句**：Experienced cyclists adjust the height of the saddle carefully, since a poor fit causes knee pain on long rides.

有经验的骑手会仔细调整车座高度，因为座高不合适会导致长途骑行时膝盖疼痛。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: safe
entries.text:
## safe

**音标**：/seɪf/

**释义**：adj. 安全的；无危险的；adj. 平安的；未受伤害的；a. 安全的；可靠的；n. 保险箱；a. 安全的；平安无事的；没有风险的；adj. 安全的

**搭配**
- safe and sound：安然无恙
- a safe place：安全的地方
- be safe from danger：免受危险

**例句**：Officials assured the public that the water was safe to drink.

官员们向公众保证饮用水是安全的。

**提示**：[族] safety n. 安全（链接P227）；[族] safely adv. 安全地；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: safeguard
entries.text:
## safeguard

**音标**：/'seɪfɡɑːd/

**释义**：vt. 保护；维护；n. 保护措施；vt. 保护，维护；n. [C] 保护措施；vt. 维护，保护，捍卫；n. 防护措施，安全措施(c)

**搭配**
- safeguard the interests of...：维护……的利益

**例句**：Local officials are using the levers that are available to them to safeguard residents' health in the face of a serious threat.

面对严重威胁，地方官员们正在使用一切可用的手段来保护居民的健康。

**提示**：shield 的近义词；n.保障条款，保护措施 v.保护，护卫；组合词:safe(安全)+guard(警卫)→警卫保护安全→保护，捍卫；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: safety
entries.text:
## safety

**音标**：/ˈseɪfti/

**释义**：n. 安全；安全性；n. [U] 安全；安全性；n. [U] 安全；平安；安全性；安全处所；n. 安全，保险；安全性；安全场所(u)；n. 安全；安全处所

**搭配**
- safety measures：安全措施
- in safety：安全地

**例句**：The new cars are tested rigorously for safety before going on sale.

新车在上市前都要经过严格的安全测试。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sage
entries.text:
## sage

**音标**：/seɪdʒ/

**释义**：n. 圣人;智者;贤人;鼠尾草；adj. 睿智的;明智的

**例句**：Villagers regarded the old teacher as a sage whose counsel was sought on every important decision.

村民们把这位老教师视为智者，每逢重大决定都要向他求教。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sail
entries.text:
## sail

**音标**：/seɪl/

**释义**：vi. 航行；启航；vt. 驾驶（船只）；n. 帆；航行；n. [C] 帆；航行；v. 航行；启航；n. 帆,航行(c)

**搭配**
- sail through：顺利通过
- set sail：扬帆；启航
- under sail：张帆地,在航行中

**例句**：They plan to sail around the world in a small boat, testing navigation equipment designed for extreme conditions.

他们计划驾小船环球航行，测试为极端环境设计的导航设备。

**提示**：[族] sailor n. 水手；[族] sailing n. 帆船运动；助记:这次sail(航行)为了递送mail(邮件);派生sailing n.航行术；启航

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sailor
entries.text:
## sailor

**音标**：/ˈseɪlə(r)/

**释义**：n. 水手；船员；n. [C] 水手，海员；n. 水手,海员

**例句**：The old sailor could predict a storm from the colour of the sky long before modern instruments confirmed it.

这位老水手早在现代仪器证实之前，就能凭天空的颜色预报风暴。

**提示**：sail(航行)+or(名词后缀表示人)→海员;a bad sailor易晕船的人

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: saint
entries.text:
## saint

**音标**：/seɪnt/

**释义**：n. 圣徒；圣人；n. 圣人,圣徒(c)；n. (Saint略作St.用于人或地名前)圣

**例句**：Villagers still tell stories of the saint who, according to legend, cured the sick with water from a nearby spring.

村民们仍在讲述那位圣徒的故事：传说他用附近泉水治愈了病人。

**提示**：sanc(神圣)的变体；[族] saintly a. 圣洁的；派生sainted adj.神圣的,被视为圣人的

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: saintly
entries.text:
## saintly

**音标**：/ˈseɪntli/

**释义**：a. 圣洁的；品德高尚的

**例句**：Her saintly patience with frightened patients made her the most trusted nurse in the entire hospital.

她对惊恐的病人怀有圣者般的耐心，这使她成为全院最受信赖的护士。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sake
entries.text:
## sake

**音标**：/seɪk/

**释义**：n. 缘故；理由；n. [U] 缘故；理由；n. （for sth.'s sake）为某事本身的缘故；n. 缘故,理由(c/u)；n. 理由；利益

**搭配**
- for the sake of：为了……起见
- for one's own sake：为了某人自己

**例句**：He gave up smoking for the sake of his health.

为了健康，他戒了烟。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: salad
entries.text:
## salad

**音标**：/'sæləd/

**释义**：n. [C,U] 色拉，凉拌菜；n. 色拉,(一盘)凉拌生菜

**例句**：Nutritionists recommend a fresh salad before the main course, since it increases fibre intake and reduces overall appetite.

营养学家建议正餐前先吃一份新鲜色拉，因为这能增加纤维摄入并降低总体食欲。

**提示**：音译“色拉”

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: salary
entries.text:
## salary

**音标**：/ˈsæləri/

**释义**：n. 薪水；薪金；n. [C][U] 薪水；薪金；n. [C,U] 薪水；n. 薪水,薪金(c/u)

**搭配**
- a monthly salary：月薪
- salary increase：加薪
- annual salary：年薪
- a rise in salary：加薪

**例句**：The survey found that graduates in finance start on a far higher salary than those entering public service.

调查发现，金融专业毕业生的起薪远高于进入公共部门的毕业生。

**提示**：[辨] salary 月薪/年薪；wage 周薪（时薪）

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sale
entries.text:
## sale

**音标**：/seɪl/

**释义**：n. 出售；销售；n. 廉价出售；拍卖；n. 出售；廉价销售；n. 销售额；n. [U] 出售；[C] 销售额；n. [C] 廉价出售

**搭配**
- for sale：待售
- on sale：出售；打折

**例句**：The sales for our May Books of the Month surpassed any month since 2018.

5月热门图书的销量超过了自2018年以来任何月份的。

**提示**：[族] salesperson n. 售货员；n.出售，销售；大减价；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: salesmansaleswomansalesperson
entries.text:
## salesmansaleswomansalesperson

**音标**：/'seɪlzmən/'seɪlzwʊmən/'seɪlzpɜːsn/

**释义**：n. 售货员,推销员

**例句**：A skilled salesperson devotes more attention to what the customer actually needs than to pushing the priciest model.

熟练的销售员更关注顾客的真实需求，而不是一味推销最贵的型号。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: salient
entries.text:
## salient

**音标**：/'seɪliənt/

**释义**：adj. 重要的;显著的;突出的

**例句**：The most salient finding of the survey is that support for the reform rises sharply with education level.

这项调查最突出的发现是：对改革的支持度随教育水平的提高而急剧上升。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: saline
entries.text:
## saline

**音标**：/'seɪlaɪn/

**释义**：n. [U] 盐水；a. 含盐的；咸的；n. 生理盐水；adj. 含盐的;咸的

**例句**：The nurse cleaned the wound with saline before applying a fresh bandage to prevent infection.

护士先用盐水清洗伤口，再换上新绷带以防感染。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: saloon
entries.text:
## saloon

**音标**：/səˈluːn/

**释义**：n. 酒馆；轿车

**例句**：The hotel's panelled saloon served as a meeting place for travelling merchants and local landowners.

旅馆里装有护墙板的客厅是往来商贩与当地地主的聚会之所。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: salt
entries.text:
## salt

**音标**：/sɔːlt/

**释义**：n. [U] 盐；vt. 腌；n. 盐,盐类；v. 腌;盐渍

**例句**：Doctors advise patients with high blood pressure to reduce the amount of salt in their daily diet.

医生建议高血压患者减少日常饮食中的盐摄入量。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: salty
entries.text:
## salty

**音标**：/'sɔːlti/

**释义**：adj. 咸的

**例句**：Health campaigns urge consumers to eat less salty food, citing the links to high blood pressure.

健康宣传活动劝告消费者少吃咸食，并列举了其与高血压的关联。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: salute
entries.text:
## salute

**音标**：/səˈluːt/

**释义**：v./n. 敬礼；致敬；v. 敬礼,致敬；祝贺；迎接,欢迎；n. 敬礼,祝贺；迎接,欢迎

**搭配**
- take the salute：还礼
- give a salute：敬礼

**例句**：The soldiers stood straight and saluted as the national flag was raised at dawn.

黎明国旗升起时，士兵们立正敬礼。

**提示**：辨析:greet见面打招呼;salute正式敬礼、鸣礼炮、升旗等;hail从远处招呼;wave挥动手臂示意

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: salvage
entries.text:
## salvage

**音标**：/ˈsælvɪdʒ/

**释义**：v./n. 抢救；打捞

**例句**：Divers worked against the approaching winter storms to salvage cargo from the wreck lying off the coast.

潜水员们赶在冬季风暴来临前，打捞沉没在近海的失事船只上的货物。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: salvation
entries.text:
## salvation

**音标**：/sæl'veɪʃn/

**释义**：n. 拯救,救助；救济品；n. 避免损失,躲避灾难等的途径或方法

**搭配**
- pray for the salvation of：祈求拯救

**例句**：For struggling hill farms, tourism has become their salvation, bringing income that sheep alone no longer provide.

对举步维艰的山区农场而言，旅游业成了它们的救星，带来了单靠养羊已无法提供的收入。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: same
entries.text:

**搭配**
- the same...as...：与……相同的

**例句**：The two laboratories reached the same conclusion independently, which greatly strengthened the credibility of the findings.

两个实验室独立得出了相同结论，这大大增强了研究结果的可信度。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sample
entries.text:
## sample

**音标**：/ˈsɑːmpl/

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sanct
entries.text:
## sanct

**音标**：/sæŋkt/

**例句**：The island is a wildlife sanctuary, and landing is strictly forbidden during the seabird breeding season.

这座岛是野生动物保护区，海鸟繁殖季节严禁登岛。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sanction
entries.text:

**释义**：n. 制裁；n. 处罚；许可；vt. 制裁；处罚；n. [C] 制裁；处罚；vt. 批准；认可；n. 制裁；批准

凡拒签该协议的国家均受到贸易制裁。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sand
entries.text:
## sand

**释义**：n. [U] 沙；[pl.] 沙滩；n. 沙;(pl.)沙滩,沙地

风把细沙刮过公路，使能见度降到不足五十米。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sandwich
entries.text:
## sandwich

**释义**：n. [C] 三明治；vt. 夹入；n. 三明治,夹肉面包(c)；vt. 夹入,挤进

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sane
entries.text:
## sane

**音标**：/seɪn/

**释义**：adj. 心智健全的,神志正常的；明智的,稳健的,理智的

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sarcastic
entries.text:

entries.subject: english2

经济学家几乎没有看到减税刺激制造业投资的证据。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seed
entries.text:
## seed

**音标**：/siːd/

**释义**：n. [C] 种子；种子选手；n. 种子；v. 播种;结实,结籽

**例句**：The agency distributes seed to farmers before the rainy season, along with advice on irrigation and soil management.

该机构在雨季前向农民发放种子，并就灌溉和土壤管理提供建议。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seek
entries.text:
## seek

**音标**：/siːk/

**释义**：vt. 寻找；寻求；vt. 试图；设法；vt. 征求；请求；v. 寻找；寻求；vt.&vi. 寻找；争取；vt. （向人）请求；寻求

**搭配**
- seek to do sth.：设法做某事
- seek advice/help：征求意见/寻求帮助
- seek after/for：追求；寻找
- seek to do sth：试图做某事

**例句**：Scientists are increasingly seeking out visual artists to help them communicate their work to new audiences.

越来越多的科学家正在寻求视觉艺术家来帮助他们向新的受众传播他们的工作。

**提示**：[族] seeker n. 追求者；探寻者；①寻求:seek long-term prosperity ②寻找:seek a job ③请求:seek permission征得许可；辨:强调对崇高目标或抽象事物的追求向往；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seeker
entries.text:
## seeker

**音标**：/ˈsiːkə(r)/

**例句**：The job fair attracted thousands of job seekers, many of them recent graduates with little work experience.

这场招聘会吸引了数千名求职者，其中许多是缺乏工作经验的应届毕业生。

**提示**：n.寻找者，探求者

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seem
entries.text:
## seem

**音标**：/siːm/

**释义**：vi. 似乎；好像；看来；vi. 似乎；好像；vi. 似乎，好像；v.-link. 好像，似乎，看来；感到好像；v. (涉及推断)好像,似乎,看来；v. 感到好像,觉得似乎

**搭配**
- it seems that...：似乎……
- seem to do sth.：好像做某事
- it seems that：似乎……

**例句**：House prices in the capital seem to have stabilized after three years of continuous increases.

在连续三年上涨之后，首都的房价似乎已经企稳。

**提示**：[辨] seem 表象；look 外观

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seemingly
entries.text:
## seemingly

**音标**：/ˈsiːmɪŋli/

**释义**：ad. 看上去；据说；adv. 表面上地;在……看来,就我们所知而言

**例句**：A seemingly minor change in the law had a major effect on how small businesses kept their records.

法律上一项看似微小的修改，对小企业的记账方式产生了重大影响。

**提示**：seeming（表面的）+ly→表面上

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seg sect
entries.text:
## seg sect

**音标**：/seɡsekt/

**释义**：切

**例句**：The final section of the report lists the measures the ministry intends to introduce over the next year.

报告的最后一节列出了该部委打算在来年推出的各项措施。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: segment
entries.text:
## segment

**音标**：/'seɡmənt/

**释义**：n. 部分；片段；n. 段；节；n. [C] 部分；段；n. 段,片,节,部分(c)；n. 部分；部门；v. 分割

**搭配**
- market segment：细分市场
- market segments：细分市场

**例句**：Big retailers must understand these differences before they can identify the segments of European wholesaling in which their particular abilities might unseat smaller but entrenched competitors.

大型零售商必须了解这些差异，才能确定欧洲批发业的细分市场，从而可能利用自己独有的能力从中挤走那些规模较小但是地位稳固的竞争者。

**提示**：[族] segmentation n. 分割；细分；n.部分，片段 v.分割，划分；词根记忆：seg(cut,切)+ment(名词后缀)→把东西切成几部分→部分；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: segregate
entries.text:
## segregate

**音标**：/'seɡrɪɡeɪt/

**释义**：v. 隔离,分离,分开；adj. 分离的,隔开的,单独的；v. 使分开，使隔离

**例句**：Pedestrians are segregated from the traffic by a metal barrier.

行人被一个金属屏障与交通隔开。

**提示**：se(分开)+greg(群体)+ate(使……)→使群体分开→隔离;派生segregation n.隔离；se(表示"分开")+greg(群体)+ate(动词后缀，使……)→使群体分开→使分开，使隔离

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seize
entries.text:
## seize

**音标**：/siːz/

**释义**：vt. 抓住；夺走；vt. 抓住；夺取；vt. 没收；扣押；vt. 抓住；捉住；夺；vt. 夺取，攻占，控制；逮捕；v. 抓住,捉住

**搭配**
- seize the opportunity：抓住机会
- seize power：夺取政权
- seize hold of：抓住,占领

**例句**：Customs officers seized a large quantity of counterfeit medicine at the port last week.

海关官员上周在港口查获了大量假药。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seldom
entries.text:
## seldom

**音标**：/ˈseldəm/

**释义**：ad. 很少；不常；adv. 很少,不常

**搭配**
- seldom go out：很少外出

**例句**：Researchers seldom publish negative results, a practice that some argue distorts the scientific record.

研究人员很少发表阴性结果，有人认为这种做法扭曲了科学记录。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: select
entries.text:
## select

**音标**：/sɪˈlekt/

**释义**：vt. 选择；挑选；v. ①选择，挑选，选拔；②(在计算机屏幕上、从菜单中)选定，选取；adj. ①精选的，选择的，优等的；②一流的，只为富人(或上层人士)而设的；vt. 选择

**搭配**
- select the best candidates：选出最佳人选

**例句**：Through carefully selected words and phrases, poems can be dramatic, funny, beautiful, moving and inspiring.

通过斟酌词句，诗歌可以是戏剧性的、滑稽有趣的、美妙迷人的、感人肺腑的，也可以是鼓舞人心的。

**提示**：辨析：select 指经过认真考虑后，仔细从中精选出最好的、最中意的；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: selection
entries.text:
## selection

**音标**：/sɪˈlekʃn/

**释义**：n. 选择；挑选；n. 精选品；n. 选择；精选品；n. ①选择，挑选，选拔(u)；②精选物，选集；入选者(c)；n. 选择

**搭配**
- natural selection：自然选择；物竞天择
- jury selection：陪审员遴选

**例句**：The selection of a new manager will take place next month.

新经理的遴选将于下个月进行。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: selective
entries.text:
## selective

**音标**：/sɪˈlektɪv/

**释义**：adj. 选择性的；仔细挑选的

**例句**：The university is highly selective, admitting fewer than one applicant in ten for its most popular courses.

这所大学选拔极为严格，最受欢迎的课程录取率不到十分之一。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: selectively
entries.text:
## selectively

**音标**：/sɪˈlektɪvli/

**释义**：adv. 有选择地

**例句**：Memory tends to work selectively, preserving flattering episodes while quietly dropping the embarrassing ones.

记忆往往有选择地发挥作用，保留体面的片段，悄悄抹去尴尬的往事。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: self
entries.text:
## self

**音标**：/self/

**释义**：n. 自己；自我；n. [C] 自己，本人；n. [U] 个人利益；私心；n. ①个性，自我，本身，自己；②(自己的)通常行为方式，本来面目，惯常心态；③个人利益；私心

**例句**：Meditation teachers claim that observing the self without judgement can reduce stress and improve concentration.

冥想导师声称，不加评判地观察自我可以减压并提高专注力。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: self-centered
entries.text:
## self-centered

**音标**：/ˌself'sentəd/

**释义**：a. 自我中心的；只考虑自己的

**例句**：Critics argue that social media encourages young people to become self-centered, caring little about the communities in which they live.

批评者认为，社交媒体促使年轻人变得自我中心，几乎不关心他们所生活的社区。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: self-deception
entries.text:
## self-deception

**音标**：/ˌselfdɪ'sepʃn/

**释义**：n. [U] 自我欺骗

**例句**：Psychologists warn that self-deception may temporarily protect our confidence, but it ultimately prevents us from correcting our real weaknesses.

心理学家警告说，自我欺骗或许能暂时保护我们的自信，但最终会妨碍我们改正真正的缺点。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: self-evident
entries.text:
## self-evident

**音标**：/ˌselfˈevɪdənt/

**释义**：adj. 明摆着的，不言而喻的

**例句**：It seems self-evident that students learn better when they get enough sleep, yet few schools adjust their timetables accordingly.

睡眠充足的学生学得更好，这似乎是不言而喻的，但很少有学校据此调整课程安排。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: self-expression
entries.text:
## self-expression

**音标**：/ˌselfɪk'spreʃn/

**释义**：n. [U] 自我表现，自我表达

**例句**：For many teenagers, painting and music are important channels of self-expression rather than merely hobbies.

对许多青少年来说，绘画和音乐是自我表达的重要渠道，而不仅仅是爱好。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: self-help
entries.text:
## self-help

**音标**：/ˌself'help/

**释义**：n. [U] 自助；自立；adj./n. 自助(的);自救(的)

**例句**：The bookshop has expanded its self-help section, reflecting growing public interest in personal development.

书店扩大了自助类图书区，反映出公众对个人成长的兴趣日益浓厚。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: self-interest
entries.text:
## self-interest

**音标**：/ˌself'ɪntrəst/

**释义**：n. [U] 自私自利；利己主义

**例句**：Economists have long assumed that firms are motivated mainly by self-interest, though cooperation is also widespread in business.

经济学家长期假定企业主要受私利驱动，但商业领域中的合作同样普遍。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: self-interested
entries.text:
## self-interested

**音标**：/ˌself'ɪntrəstɪd;ˌself'ɪntrestɪd/

**释义**：adj. 利己主义的,自私的

**例句**：The proposal was attacked as a self-interested attempt by wealthy countries to protect their own industries.

该提案被指责为富裕国家保护自身产业的利己企图。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: self-rule
entries.text:
## self-rule

**音标**：/ˌself'ruːl/

**释义**：n. [U] 自治

**例句**：After decades of struggle, the colony finally won self-rule and began to build its own political institutions.

经过数十年的斗争，该殖民地终于赢得自治，并开始建立自己的政治制度。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: selfish
entries.text:
## selfish

**音标**：/ˈselfɪʃ/

**释义**：a. 自私的；a. 自私的；利己的；adj. 自私的，利己的

**搭配**
- selfish behaviour：自私的行为

**例句**：Critics called the decision selfish, arguing that it protected the company's profits at the workers' expense.

批评者称这一决定自私，认为它以牺牲工人利益为代价保护公司利润。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sell
entries.text:
## sell

**音标**：/sel/

**释义**：v. 卖；售；v. 卖；销售；出卖；v. 出让，转让；出售，售卖；n. 让人失望的东西

**搭配**
- sell out：卖光；出售

**例句**：The museum cannot legally sell any of the paintings donated to it a century ago.

按规定，博物馆不能合法出售一个世纪前捐赠给它的任何画作。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seller
entries.text:
## seller

**音标**：/'selə(r)/

**例句**：The online seller promised delivery within two days, but complaints about delayed orders continued to rise.

这位网上卖家承诺两天内送货，但关于订单延迟的投诉仍在不断增加。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: semble
entries.text:
## semble

**音标**：/ˈsembl/

**释义**：一起；相同的

**例句**：Words such as assemble and resemble share the root semble, which means together or like, and they appear frequently in academic texts.

assemble 与 resemble 等词共享词根 semble，意为“相同、一起”，它们在学术文章中经常出现。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: semester
entries.text:
## semester

**音标**：/sɪˈmestə(r)/

**释义**：n. 学期；n. 学期(c)

**例句**：I was finishing my last semester in college and trying to look for a job.

我当时即将结束最后一个学期的大学生活，正想找份工作。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: semiconductor
entries.text:
## semiconductor

**音标**：/,semikən'dʌktə(r)/

**释义**：n. 半导体

**例句**：The global shortage of semiconductor chips forced several car factories to halt production for weeks.

全球半导体芯片短缺迫使多家汽车工厂停产数周。

**提示**：semi(half半)+conductor(导体)→半导体

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seminar
entries.text:
## seminar

**音标**：/ˈsemɪnɑː(r)/

**释义**：n. 研讨会；n. (大学的)研究班,研讨会(c)；n. 研讨课，研讨会，培训会

**搭配**
- in a seminar room：在研讨室里

**例句**：Professor Mackay will give a seminar on Pound's poetry.

麦凯教授将开设一个关于庞德诗歌的研讨课。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sen
entries.text:
## sen

**音标**：/sen/

**释义**：老；老的

**例句**：Derived from the root sen, meaning old, words such as senior and senate originally referred to the elder members of society.

senior 与 senate 等词源自意为“老”的词根 sen，原本指社会中的年长者。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: senate
entries.text:
## senate

**音标**：/'senət/

**释义**：n. 参议院；n. 参议院,上院(u)

**例句**：The bill was approved by the senate after a debate that lasted late into the night.

经过一场持续到深夜的辩论后，该法案获得了参议院的批准。

**提示**：派生senatorial adj.参议院的,上院的；n.参议院；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: senator
entries.text:
## senator

**音标**：/'senətə(r)/

**释义**：n. 参议员(c)；n. 参议员

**例句**：The senator was invited but was unable to attend.

参议员受到了邀请，但是未能出席。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: send
entries.text:
## send

**音标**：/send/

**释义**：vt. 送；寄；vt. 派遣；vt. 邮寄；发送；派遣；打发；安排去；v. ①发送，传达，转致；②派遣，打发，安排去；③使快速移动；使做出(某种反应)，使表现出(某种行为)

**搭配**
- send for：派人去请
- send out：发送；派出

**例句**：The university will send admissions decisions by email at the end of March.

大学将于三月底通过电子邮件发送录取结果。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: senior
entries.text:
## senior

**音标**：/'siːniə(r)/

**释义**：a. 年长的；地位较高的；n. 较年长者；前辈；a. 年长的；资深的；n. [C] 前辈；上司；adj. ①年长的 ②资格老的，地位较高的；③(比赛)成人的；高水平的

**搭配**
- a senior official：高级官员
- senior citizens：老年人

**例句**：I have ten years' experience at senior management level.

我有十年的高层管理经验。

**提示**：派生 seniority n. 年长；资历深；adj.年龄大些的;年长的； 高级的 n.较年长的人；长者；地 位较高者；sen（年老）+ior（较……的）→年长的；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seniority
entries.text:
## seniority

**音标**：/ˌsiːniˈɒrəti/

**释义**：n. 年长；资历

**例句**：Promotion in the company depends on merit rather than seniority, which encourages younger employees to compete.

该公司的晋升取决于能力而非资历，这鼓励了年轻员工展开竞争。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sens sent
entries.text:
## sens sent

**音标**：/sens/

**释义**：感觉

**例句**：Because the root sens or sent means to feel, it appears in words describing emotion and perception, such as sensible and sensitive.

由于词根 sens 或 sent 意为“感觉”，它出现在描述情感与感知的词汇中，例如 sensible 和 sensitive。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sensation
entries.text:
## sensation

**音标**：/senˈseɪʃn/

**释义**：n. ①(身体上的)感觉，知觉(c)；n. ②感觉能力，知觉能力(u)；③激动；轰动，轰动一时的事情(c)；n. 感觉（能力），知觉（能力）；轰动

**例句**：News of his arrest caused a sensation.

他被捕的消息引起了轰动。

**提示**：派生 sensational adj. 耸人听闻的，轰动的

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sensational
entries.text:
## sensational

**音标**：/sen'seɪʃənl/

**释义**：adj. 引起轰动的;哗众取宠的;极好的;绝妙的；adj. 轰动的；耸人听闻的

**例句**：Their sometimes sensational findings were filled with warnings about the growing competition from overseas.

有时他们那些耸人听闻的发现里充满了对海外竞争日益增长的警告之词。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sense
entries.text:
## sense

**音标**：/sens/

**释义**：n. 感觉；观念；vt. 意识到；n. [C] 感觉；道理；vt. 感觉到；意识到；n. ①感觉，感官，官能(c)；②观念，意识；③判断力，鉴赏力；④见识，智慧；⑤道理，合理性；⑥意义，含义(c)

- make sense：有意义
- in a sense：在某种意义上
- a sense of humor：幽默感
- come to one's senses：恢复理性，醒悟过来

**例句**：When more and more of us have a degree, it makes sense to have two.

当我们中越来越多的人拥有一个学位时，拥有两个学位是有意义的。

**提示**：另 make sense 讲得通，言之成理；sense of security安全感；make sense有意义；说得通；in one sense在某种意义上；common sense常识；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: senseless
entries.text:
## senseless

**音标**：/'sensləs/

**释义**：adj. 愚蠢的，无意义的；无知觉的

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sensible
entries.text:
## sensible

**音标**：/'sensəbl/

**释义**：a. 明智的；合理的；adj. ①明智的，合情理的；②可注意到的，明显的；adj. 明智的，合理的；adj. 明智的

**搭配**
- a sensible decision：明智的决定

**例句**：The sensible place to build new houses, factories and offices is where people are, in cities and towns where infrastructure is in place.

建造新房子、工厂和办公室的明智地点是在人多的地方，在基础设施完备的城镇。

**提示**：sensible（明智的）vs sensitive（敏感的）；adj.理智的，合理的；实用的； 可感觉到的，明显的；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sensitive
entries.text:
## sensitive

**音标**：/'sensətɪv/

**释义**：a. 敏感的；灵敏的；a. 过敏的；易受影响的；adj. ①敏感的；易受伤害的；艺术感觉好的；②灵敏的，灵敏度高的；③体贴的，善解人意的；adj. 敏感的；过敏的；体贴的；感觉敏锐的

**搭配**
- be sensitive to：对……敏感
- a sensitive issue：敏感问题
- sensitive data：敏感数据
- sensitive information：敏感信息

**例句**：But keeping sensitive information on these devices is increasingly a requirement of normal life.

而在这些设备上保存敏感信息越来越成为日常生活的一种需求。

**提示**：adj.灵敏的；体恤的；敏感的；；sens(感,感觉)+itive(形容词后缀)→敏感的；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sensitiveness
entries.text:
## sensitiveness

**音标**：/ˈsensətɪvnəs/

**释义**：n. 灵敏度

**例句**：The instrument's sensitiveness allows researchers to detect extremely small changes in air temperature.

该仪器的高灵敏度使研究人员能够探测到气温的极微小变化。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sensitivity
entries.text:
## sensitivity

**音标**：/ˌsensə'tɪvəti/

**释义**：n. 体贴,体谅;悟性;敏感性；n. （信息、话题等的）敏感性；体贴；过敏性；灵敏度；神经过敏；悟性

**例句**：Her sensitivity to students' worries made her the most trusted teacher in the school.

她对学生的忧虑体贴入微，这使她成为全校最值得信赖的老师。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sensor
entries.text:
## sensor

**音标**：/'sensə(r)/

**释义**：n. [C] (探测光、热、压力等的)传感器，敏感元件；n. 传感器;敏感元件;探测设备；n. （探测光、热、压力等的）传感器，探测设备

**例句**：A sensor detects when the temperature falls and switches on the heating automatically.

传感器探测到温度下降时会自动开启供暖。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sensory
entries.text:
## sensory

**音标**：/'sensəri/

**释义**：adj. 知觉的,感觉的,感觉中枢的

**例句**：The study examines how sensory information from the environment is processed by the developing brain.

该研究考察发育中的大脑如何处理来自环境的感官信息。

**提示**：adj.感觉的，感官的

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sensual
entries.text:
## sensual

**音标**：/'senʃuəl/

**释义**：a. 感官的；喜欢感官享受的；adj. 感官的,肉欲的,愉悦感官的,喜欢感官享受的,耽于肉欲的

**例句**：Critics praised the film's sensual imagery, noting how every scene appeals directly to the viewer's senses.

评论家称赞影片诉诸感官的意象，指出每个画面都直接唤起观众的感官体验。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sent
entries.text:
## sent

**音标**：/sent/

**释义**：存在

**例句**：The root sent, meaning to exist or be present, lies behind such everyday words as presence, essential and absentee.

词根 sent 意为“存在”，是 presence、essential 和 absentee 等常用词的来源。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sent senc
entries.text:
## sent senc

**音标**：/sent/

**释义**：存在

**例句**：Because senc and sent both mean to exist, they combine with prefixes to form words like absent, present and essence.

由于 senc 与 sent 都表示“存在”，它们与前缀结合构成 absent、present 和 essence 等词。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sent sens
entries.text:
## sent sens

**音标**：/sens/

**释义**：感觉

**例句**：Consent, dissent and resent all contain the root sent or sens, which carries the basic meaning of feeling.

consent、dissent 和 resent 都包含词根 sent 或 sens，其基本含义是“感觉”。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sentence
entries.text:
## sentence

**音标**：/ˈsentəns/

**释义**：n. 句子；n. 判决；判刑；n. [C] 句子；n. [C] 判决；判刑；vt. 判决；宣判；n. 句子(c)

**搭配**
- a life sentence：无期徒刑
- be sentenced to death：被判处死刑
- receive a heavy sentence：受到重判

**例句**：The judge reduced the prison sentence after the defendant showed genuine remorse and repaid the victims.

被告真诚悔悟并赔偿受害者后，法官减轻了刑期。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sentiment
entries.text:
## sentiment

**音标**：/'sentɪmənt/

**释义**：n. [C][U] 情绪；感情；n. 情操,情感,情绪,多愁善感；意见,观点；n. 观点；情绪

**搭配**
- public sentiment：公众情绪
- anti-immigrant sentiment：反移民情绪

**例句**：At the next election none of the big parties seem likely to endorse this sentiment.

在下一轮的选举中似乎没有一个大的政党认同这种观点。

**提示**：派生sentimental adj.情感的,情绪的;sentimentalist n.情感柔弱的人；n.观点，情绪；多愁善感，伤 感情绪；n.观点，看法，情绪；多愁善 感；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sentimental
entries.text:
## sentimental

**音标**：/ˌsentɪ'mentl/

**例句**：He kept the old watch for sentimental reasons, although it had stopped working years before.

他出于感情原因保留着那块旧手表，尽管它多年前就已停走。

**提示**：adj.情感的；多愁善感的

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: separate
entries.text:
## separate

**音标**：/ˈseprət/

**释义**：a. 分开的；不同的；v. （使）分开，隔开；a. 单独的；分开的；v. （使）分开；隔开；adj. ①分开的，分离的；单独的；②不同的；不相关的

**搭配**
- separate...from...：把……和……分开
- a separate room：独立的房间
- be separated from：与……分离
- separate from：与……分开

**例句**：One reason why it is hard to design and teach such courses is that they cut across the insistence by top American universities that liberal-arts education and professional education should be kept separate, taught in different schools.

这些课程难以开设和讲授的原因在于，它们有悖于美国一流大学一贯坚持的原则，即人文艺术教育与专业教育应保持分离，且分别由不同的院校来授课。

**提示**：派生 separated adj. 分居的，分开的；separately adv. 分别地，单独地；separation n. 分离；分隔；(夫妻)分居；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: separately
entries.text:
## separately

**音标**：/ˈsepərətli/

**释义**：ad. 分别地；分离地

**例句**：The two experiments were conducted separately so that neither group of participants could influence the other.

两项实验分别进行，以便两组参与者互不影响。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: separation
entries.text:
## separation

**音标**：/,sepə'reɪʃn/

**释义**：n. 分离；分开；n. 分离；间隔

**例句**：The separation of powers prevents any single branch of government from dominating the other two.

权力分立可防止政府任何一个分支支配另外两个分支。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sept
entries.text:
## sept

**音标**：/sept/

**释义**：September；九月

**例句**：Sept is the short form of September, the ninth month of the year, when many universities welcome their new students.

Sept 是 September（九月）的缩写，这个月许多大学迎来新生。

**提示**：附录Ⅲ 缩写词

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: september
entries.text:
## september

**音标**：/sep'tembə(r)/

**释义**：n. [U,C] 九月

**例句**：Many universities admit new students in September, with a smaller second intake in January.

许多大学在九月招收新生，一月还有较小规模的第二次入学。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sequ secut
entries.text:
## sequ secut

**音标**：/ˈsiːkw/

**释义**：跟随

**例句**：The Latin root sequ or secut, meaning to follow, appears in such common words as consequence, sequence and execute.

拉丁词根 sequ 或 secut 意为“跟随”，出现在 consequence、sequence 和 execute 等常见词中。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sequence
entries.text:
## sequence

**音标**：/ˈsiːkwəns/

**释义**：n. 顺序；一系列；n. [C] 顺序；连续；n. ①先后，次序，连续(c/u)；②一系列，一连串(c)；n. 一连串，一系列；顺序；n. 一系列，一连串；顺序，次序

**搭配**
- a sequence of：一系列
- in sequence：按顺序
- a sequence of events：一连串事件
- a sequence of images：一系列图像

**例句**：He had to attend a sequence of meetings.

他得参加一系列会议。

**提示**：n.顺序，次序；一连串，一系列 v.按顺序排列；测定...序列；词根记忆：sequ(follow，跟随)+ence(表性质，状态)→一个跟一个→一连串；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seri
entries.text:
## seri

**音标**：/ˈsɪəri/

**释义**：系列

**例句**：Words like series and serial contain the root seri, which suggests a chain or sequence of connected things.

series、serial 等词都包含词根 seri，表示一连串相互关联的事物。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: serial
entries.text:
## serial

**音标**：/ˈsɪəriəl/

**释义**：adj. 连续的；连续广播的，连载的；顺序排列的；n. 连载小说，连续电视；定期刊物(c)；n. 连续剧，连载故事

**例句**：The newspaper published the novelist's latest story as a serial, printing one chapter every Sunday.

报社将这位小说家的最新作品作为连载刊出，每周日刊登一章。

**提示**：派生 serialize v. 连载或连播(某内容)；serialization n. 连载

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: serially
entries.text:
## serially

**音标**：/'sɪəriəli/

**释义**：adv. 连载地；连续地

**例句**：The novel was published serially in a magazine before it appeared as a single volume.

这部小说先在杂志上连载，随后才以单行本形式出版。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: series
entries.text:
## series

**音标**：/ˈsɪəriːz/

**释义**：n. 一系列；n. [C] 一系列；连续；n. 连续，一系列(c)；n. 连续，一系列；系列节目；n. 一系列；系列节目

**搭配**
- a series of：一系列
- in series：连续地
- a series of experiments：一系列实验
- TV series：电视剧

**例句**：Yet humans remain fascinated by the idea of robots that would look, move, and respond like humans, similar to those recently depicted on popular sci-fi TV series such as "Westworld" and "Humans".

然而，人类仍然对机器人的想法着迷，机器人的外观、移动和响应都像人类，就像最近在流行的科幻电视连续剧《西部世界》和《人类》中描述的那样。

**提示**：发音类似"serious(严重的)"→严重的事情(通常是祸)一发生就是一连串的→连续，一系列；另:a series of decisions一系列决定/a complex series of factors一系列复杂因素；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: serious
entries.text:
## serious

**音标**：/ˈsɪəriəs/

**释义**：a. 严重的；严肃的；a. 稳重的；严肃的；严重的；重要的；认真的；adj. ①严肃的，庄重的；②严重的，危险的；③认真的

**搭配**
- a serious problem：严重的问题
- serious illness：重病

**例句**：Doctors warned that the patient's condition was serious and that the operation could not be postponed.

医生警告病人病情严重，手术不能再推迟。

**提示**：派生 seriousness n. 严肃，认真；严重性；seriously adv. 严肃地，认真地；严重地

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seriously
entries.text:
## seriously

**音标**：/'sɪəriəsli/

**释义**：adv. 严重地；认真地；严肃地

**例句**：Health officials take the spread of the new virus seriously and have urged the public to remain calm.

卫生官员高度重视新病毒的传播，并敦促公众保持冷静。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: seriousness
entries.text:
## seriousness

**音标**：/'sɪərɪəsnəs/

**释义**：n. [U,sing.] 严肃；认真；严重

**例句**：The report emphasized the seriousness of climate change and called for immediate international cooperation.

报告强调了气候变化的严重性，并呼吁立即开展国际合作。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sermon
entries.text:
## sermon

**音标**：/'sɜːmən/

**释义**：n. 布道,说教;(令人生厌的)冗长讲话

**例句**：The bishop's sermon on forgiveness moved many members of the congregation to tears.

主教关于宽恕的布道令许多会众落泪。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sert
entries.text:
## sert

**音标**：/sɜːt/

**释义**：加入

**例句**：The root sert, meaning to join or put in, helps form verbs such as insert, assert and exert.

词根 sert 意为“加入、插入”，构成了 insert、assert 和 exert 等动词。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: serv
entries.text:
## serv

**音标**：/sɜːv/

**释义**：注视；服务；服务

**例句**：The root serv can mean to serve, as in service and servant, or to keep watch over, as in observe and conserve.

词根 serv 既可表示“服务”，如 service 和 servant，也可表示“注视、保存”，如 observe 和 conserve。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: serv serve
entries.text:
## serv serve

**音标**：/sɜːv/

**释义**：保持

**例句**：In reserve and preserve, the root serv or serve means to keep or hold back rather than to serve.

在 reserve 和 preserve 中，词根 serv 或 serve 表示“保持、保留”，而非“服务”。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: servant
entries.text:
## servant

**音标**：/'sɜːvənt/

**释义**：n. 仆人,佣人,佣工;雇员;忠于某人(某事)的人

**例句**：In the nineteenth century, a single servant often had to cook, clean and care for the entire household.

在十九世纪，一名仆人往往要为全家人做饭、打扫并照料日常起居。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: serve
entries.text:
## serve

**音标**：/sɜːv/

**释义**：v. 服务；供职；vt. 提供；端上；vt.&vi. （给某人）提供；服务；vt. 对……有用；v. 服务,履行职责；v. 接待(顾客)或为顾客取来(货物);有用,起作用

**搭配**
- serve the people：为人民服务
- serve as：充当；担任
- serve sb. right：给某人以应得的惩罚
- serve clients：服务客户

**例句**：California's plan, which is expected to be finalized by the governor next year, should serve as a model.

加利福尼亚州的计划有望在明年由州长最终敲定，它应该成为一个典范。

**提示**：v.服务；提供，端上；接 待；词根记忆：serv(服务)+e→为（人、机构）服务；词根 serv=to serve 服务, to keep 保持；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: service
entries.text:
## service

**音标**：/ˈsɜːvɪs/

**释义**：n. [C] 服务；服务性工作；n. [U] 公共事业；n. 服务,帮助;公共设施,公共事业；n. 维修,保养;行政部门,服务机构；vt. 维修,保养；n. 服务；国家政府部门

**搭配**
- public services：公共服务
- a service industry：服务行业
- at sb.'s service：随时帮助某人
- be of service to：有用,有帮助

**例句**：Google and Microsoft are among companies that already have these "single sign-on" systems that make it possible for users to log in just once but use many different services.

许多公司都有"单次登录"系统，可使用户仅登录一次便可以享受多项不同服务，谷歌和微软正位列其中。

**提示**：2019年阅读例：Small businesses and internet entrepreneurs are not well served at all by this decision. 这项裁决对小企业和互联网企业家们完全没有帮助；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: session
entries.text:
## session

**音标**：/ˈseʃn/

**释义**：n. [C] 一场；一节；n. [C] 会议；开庭；n. 会议,(一届)会议(c),一段时间；n. 一场，一节；会议；（法庭的）开庭；（议会等的）会议

**搭配**
- a training session：培训课
- in session：在开会

**例句**：We have both elementary and advanced training sessions.

我们有初级和高级培训课程。

**提示**：发音类似“塞心”→一想到这周要开这么多的“会议”，我就感觉心塞→会议。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: set
entries.text:
## set

**音标**：/set/

**释义**：v. 放置；设定；n. [C] 一套；一副；vt. 放；置；树立；设置；n. 一套，一副，一组；v. (set,set)放置;确定,决定;树立;校正,调整;落山,下沉；n. 一套,一副,一组;电气(或电子)器械

**搭配**
- set up：建立
- set out：出发；着手
- a set of：一组，一套，一副

**例句**：The growth of higher education manifests itself in at least three quite different ways, and these in turn have given rise to different sets of problems.

高等教育的发展至少表现在三种完全不同的方式上,而这些又产生不同的问题。

**提示**：set about着手;set aside留出,不顾;set off出发,激起;set up创立;set down写下;set forth阐明；小记：set sth./sb. back 使推迟，使延误；set in 到来，开始；set off 出发，起程；set out 出发，动身；set sth. out 安排，摆放

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: setback
entries.text:
## setback

**音标**：/'setbæk/

**释义**：n. 挫折,退步；n. (病的)复发;延迟,阻碍；n. 挫折，阻碍；n. 挫折

**搭配**
- deal with setbacks：处理挫折
- in times of financial setback：在经济受挫的时候

**例句**：The transition from school to work can be less of a setback if the start-up adult is ready for the move.

如果这个准成年人做好了从学校向职场过渡的准备，那么在这一转变过程中就不会那么受挫了。

**提示**：拓展记忆：和词组 set back（延误）一起记；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: setter
entries.text:
## setter

**音标**：/ˈsetə(r)/

**释义**：n. 制订者

**搭配**
- accounting standard-setters：会计准则的制订者

**例句**：The setter of the examination insisted that the questions reflected what students had actually been taught.

试卷命题人坚称，试题反映了学生实际所学的内容。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: setting
entries.text:
## setting

**音标**：/'setɪŋ/

**释义**：n. 安置,安装；n. 环境,背景

**例句**：The study compares children's reading habits in the home setting and in the classroom.

该研究比较了儿童在家庭和课堂环境中的阅读习惯。

**提示**：辨析:setting指事情发生或所处的环境、背景;environment指影响人的思想行为或事物发展的环境;surroundings指周围环境；n.环境；场景，背景；档位；设 置

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: settle
entries.text:
## settle

**音标**：/'setl/

**释义**：v. 解决；定居；vi. 安顿；安定下来；vi. 安定,安顿;停息,定居；vi. 解决,调停；v. 定居；解决；v. 结束（争论、争端等）；定居；（最终）决定；使处于舒适的位置；（使）平静下来

**搭配**
- settle down：安定下来

**释义**：n. 壳,贝壳;炮弹(c /u)

**例句**：The beach was covered with shells of every shape, which the children collected eagerly.

海滩上满是各种形状的贝壳，孩子们兴致勃勃地拾捡。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shellfish
entries.text:
## shellfish

**音标**：/'ʃelfiʃ/

**释义**：n. [C,U] 贝类，甲壳类动物

**例句**：Doctors advised him to avoid shellfish because they could trigger a severe allergic reaction.

医生建议他避免食用贝类，因为那可能引发严重的过敏反应。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shelter
entries.text:
## shelter

**音标**：/'ʃeltə(r)/

**释义**：n. [C] 避难所；庇护；vt. 掩蔽；庇护；n. 掩蔽处,躲避处；n. 掩蔽,保护；v. 掩蔽,庇护,提供避难所;躲避,避难；n. 居所；遮蔽；避难所

**搭配**
- shelter from the rain：避雨
- a homeless shelter：流浪者收容所
- give shelter to sb.：庇护某人
- under the shelter of：在…的庇护下,受…的保护

**例句**：They were anxious to find shelter for the night.

他们急于找个地方过夜。

**提示**：发音类似“歇（休息）了他”→为了救助难民，他实在太累了，在“避难所”休息一下。；串词记忆：小小的架子(shelf)不能帮我遮蔽(shelter)风雨；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shepherd
entries.text:
## shepherd

**音标**：/'ʃepəd/

**释义**：n. [C] 牧羊人；vt. 带领，引导（人群）；n. 牧民,牧羊人；v. 带领;护送

**例句**：The shepherd led the flock across the narrow bridge moments before the flood reached the valley.

牧羊人赶着羊群通过狭窄的桥，片刻之后洪水便抵达了山谷。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shield
entries.text:
## shield

**音标**：/ʃiːld/

**释义**：n. 盾；护罩；vt. 保护；庇护；n. [C] 盾；屏障；v. 保护,保卫;庇护,掩盖；n. 盾,保护物,防御物

**搭配**
- shield...from...：保护……免受……
- shield ... from ...：保护...免受...
- a heat shield：隔热屏

**例句**：The ozone layer shields the earth from the sun's harmful rays.

臭氧层保护地球免受太阳有害射线的伤害。

**提示**：近义：safeguard vt. 保护；[近]protect vt. 保护；同义:safeguard,protect;shelter；n.盾(牌)；防护物 v.保护

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shift
entries.text:
## shift

**音标**：/ʃɪft/

**释义**：v./n. 转变；转移；n. 轮班；轮班工作时间；v. 转移；改变；n. [C] 转变；轮班；vt.&vi. 转移；改变；n. 轮班

**搭配**
- shift...onto/to...：把……转移到……
- a shift in...：……的转变
- day/night shift：白班/夜班
- shift attention to：把注意力转移到

**例句**：Most of the money would come from a penny-per-letter permanent rate increase and from shifting postal retirees into Medicare.

大部分资金将来自每封信一美分的永久性费率增加以及将邮政退休人员转入美国国家医疗保险制度。

**提示**：switch 的近义词；shift off 推卸,逃避;同义:change,substitute；v.转移，改变；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shin
entries.text:
## shin

**音标**：/ʃɪn/

**释义**：n. 胫,胫骨;小腿肉；v. 攀,爬

**例句**：He bruised his shin against the low table but continued playing as if nothing had happened.

他的小腿撞上了矮桌，淤青了一块，但他装作没事继续玩。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shine
entries.text:
## shine

**音标**：/ʃaɪn/

**释义**：vi. 照耀；发光；vt. 擦亮；vi. 发光；反光；照耀；vt. 擦亮；擦光；n. [sing.] 光亮；vt. (shone,shone) 照耀,发光

**搭配**
- shine brightly：明亮地照耀

**例句**：The morning sun began to shine through the fog, revealing a harbour crowded with fishing boats.

晨光开始穿透雾霭照耀下来，显露出挤满渔船的港口。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: ship
entries.text:
## ship

**音标**：/ʃip/

**释义**：n. [C] 轮船，舰；vt. 运送

**例句**：The factory ships its furniture to customers across the country within ten working days.

工厂在十个工作日内把家具运送给全国各地的客户。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shipload
entries.text:
## shipload

**音标**：/'ʃɪpləʊd/

**释义**：n. 船只运载量；n. 船货；船只装载量

**例句**：A shipload of grain arrived at the port this morning.

今晨一船粮食抵达港口。

**提示**：n.船货；船舶运载量；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shipment
entries.text:
## shipment

**音标**：/ˈʃɪpmənt/

**释义**：n. 装船,装运,装载的货物,装载量(c/u)

**例句**：A shipment of medical supplies was delayed at customs for nearly two weeks because of incomplete paperwork.

由于单据不全，一批医疗物资在海关滞留了近两周。

**提示**：ship(船)+ment(名词后缀)→装运；n.运输，运送；运输的货 物

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shipper
entries.text:
## shipper

**音标**：/'ʃɪpə(r)/

**例句**：The shipper remains responsible for the goods until they are loaded onto the vessel at the port.

在货物于港口装上船只之前，发货人对其负有责任。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shirt
entries.text:
## shirt

**音标**：/ʃəːt/

**释义**：n. [C] 衬衫

**例句**：The players exchanged shirts after the match, a tradition that dates back more than half a century.

比赛结束后球员们互相交换了球衣，这一传统可追溯到半个多世纪以前。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shiver
entries.text:
## shiver

**音标**：/'ʃɪvə(r)/

**释义**：vi. 战栗,发抖

**例句**：A cold wind made the campers shiver, so they gathered closer around the fire.

冷风让露营者们直打寒战，于是他们朝篝火凑得更近了。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shock
entries.text:
## shock

**音标**：/ʃɒk/

**释义**：n. 震惊；惊愕；休克；vt. 使震惊；n. 震动,冲击,电击(c)；n. 休克；vt. (使)震动,(使)震惊

**例句**：The news of his death came as a great shock to everyone.

他去世的消息让所有人都深感震惊。

**提示**：派生shocking adj.骇人的；令人激动的；极坏的；v.使震惊，使难以置信 n.令人震惊的事；吃惊，震惊

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shoe
entries.text:
## shoe

**音标**：/ʃuː/

**释义**：n. [C] 鞋

**例句**：The demand for handmade leather shoes has risen sharply as more consumers begin to value quality over price.

随着越来越多的消费者开始重视质量而非价格，手工皮鞋的需求急剧上升。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shoot
entries.text:
## shoot

**音标**：/ʃuːt/

**释义**：v. (shot,shot) 射击,发射,开(枪),放(炮)；v. 突然迅速地移动；发芽；n. 狩猎,狩猎队,狩猎场；嫩枝,幼苗

**例句**：The director plans to shoot the final scene on location in the mountains next spring.

导演计划明年春天在山区的实景地拍摄最后一幕。

**提示**：词组shoot up迅速升起;快速成长;shoot down击落,射下;shoot off放(枪),开(炮)

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shop
entries.text:
## shop

**音标**：/ʃɔp/

**释义**：n. [C] 商店；车间；vi. 购物

**例句**：Small shops in the town center have struggled to survive since the giant supermarket opened nearby.

自从大型超市在附近开业以来，镇中心的小商店一直在艰难求生。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shopping
entries.text:
## shopping

**音标**：/'ʃɔpiŋ/

**释义**：n. [U] 购物

**例句**：Online shopping has changed consumer habits so thoroughly that many stores in the high street have closed.

网购彻底改变了消费习惯，以至于许多商业街的店铺已经关门。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shore
entries.text:
## shore

**音标**：/ʃɔː/

**释义**：n. [C] （海、湖等的）滨，岸；n. 海滨,湖滨(c /u)

**例句**：Waves carried plastic waste to the shore, reminding tourists of the urgent need to protect the marine environment.

海浪把塑料垃圾冲上岸，提醒游客保护海洋环境刻不容缓。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: short
entries.text:
## short

**音标**：/ʃɔːt/

**释义**：a. 短的；个子矮的；短暂的；ad. 未达到；不及；adj. 短的,矮的;(of)缺乏,不足；n. (pl.)短裤

**例句**：The company's supply of raw materials fell short of demand, forcing it to delay the launch of its new product.

公司原材料供应供不应求，被迫推迟新产品上市。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: short-term
entries.text:
## short-term

**音标**：/ˌʃɔːt'tɜːm/

**释义**：a. 短期的；近期的

**例句**：Critics say the government's short-term policies sacrifice long-term investment in education and infrastructure.

批评者说，政府的短期政策牺牲了对教育和基础设施的长期投资。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: short-termism
entries.text:
## short-termism

**音标**：/ˌʃɔːt'tɜːmɪzəm/

**释义**：n. 短期效益主义;短期行为

**例句**：Shareholders blamed the company's decline on short-termism, which discouraged spending on research.

股东们将公司的衰落归咎于短期效益主义，因为它打击了研发投入。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shortage
entries.text:
## shortage

**音标**：/ˈʃɔːtɪdʒ/

**释义**：n. [C][U] 不足；短缺；n. 不足,缺少(c)；n. 不足，缺乏；n. 缺少

**搭配**
- a shortage of water：缺水
- labor shortage：劳动力短缺
- housing shortage：住房短缺
- worker shortages：劳动力短缺

**例句**：There is no shortage of things to do in the town.

城里不愁找不到活儿干。

**提示**：short(短)+age(名词后缀)→缺少；n.短缺，不足；short（短的，引申为“短缺”）+age（名词后缀）→缺乏；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shortcoming
entries.text:
## shortcoming

**音标**：/ˈʃɔːtkʌmɪŋ/

**释义**：n. [C] 缺点；短处；n. 短处,缺点(c)；n. 缺点，短处

**搭配**
- overcome one's shortcomings：克服缺点

**例句**：There were obvious shortcomings in the report.

这个报告有明显瑕疵。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shortcut
entries.text:
## shortcut

**音标**：/'ʃɔːtkʌt/

**释义**：n. 近路,捷径;快捷方式

**例句**：Experienced programmers know that there is no shortcut to writing reliable and secure code.

经验丰富的程序员知道，编写可靠、安全的代码没有捷径可走。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shorten
entries.text:
## shorten

**音标**：/ˈʃɔːtn/

**释义**：v. (使)变短，缩短

**例句**：The new bridge will shorten the journey between the two cities by nearly two hours.

新桥将使两座城市之间的行程缩短近两个小时。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shortfall
entries.text:
## shortfall

**音标**：/'ʃɔːtfɔːl/

**释义**：n. 不足

**搭配**
- make up for that shortfall：弥补不足

**例句**：The charity faced a serious funding shortfall and had to cut several community programmes.

该慈善机构面临严重的资金缺口，不得不削减几个社区项目。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shorthand
entries.text:
## shorthand

**音标**：/'ʃɔːthænd/

**释义**：n. 速记(u)；n. 速记(法)；(对某事)简略的表达方式

**例句**：Journalists once relied on shorthand to record interviews accurately, but digital recorders have largely replaced this skill.

新闻记者过去依靠速记准确记录采访内容，但数码录音笔已在很大程度上取代了这项技能。

**提示**：short(短)+hand(手)→短时间用手写→速记；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shorts
entries.text:
## shorts

**音标**：/ʃɔːts/

**释义**：n. [pl.] 短裤

**例句**：Wear shorts and trainers for the fun run, and bring a bottle of water because the weather may be hot.

参加趣味跑请穿短裤和运动鞋，并带一瓶水，因为天气可能很热。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shot
entries.text:
## shot

**音标**：/ʃɒt/

**释义**：n. [C] 射击；投篮；n. [C] 照片；尝试；n. 开枪,射击；投篮(c/u)；n. 弹丸,炮弹,子弹

**搭配**
- have a shot at：尝试一下

**例句**：The vaccine requires a second shot within six months to ensure long-lasting protection against the virus.

这种疫苗需要在六个月内注射第二针，以确保对病毒的长期保护。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: should
entries.text:
## should

**音标**：/ʃəd/

**释义**：modal v. 应该，应当；本应；可能；万一

**例句**：Governments should invest more in public transport if they hope to reduce traffic congestion and air pollution.

如果政府希望缓解交通拥堵和空气污染，就应该加大对公共交通的投入。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shoulder
entries.text:
## shoulder

**音标**：/ˈʃəʊldə(r)/

**释义**：n. 肩膀；（衣服的）肩部；山肩；瓶肩；n. [C] 肩，肩膀；路肩；n. 肩膀,肩部；vt. 肩负,承担

**搭配**
- shoulder to shoulder：并肩;协力

**例句**：Senior managers must shoulder the responsibility for the company's failure to respond to the crisis in time.

高层管理人员必须为公司未能及时应对危机承担责任。

**提示**：put one's shoulder to the wheel 全力以赴

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shout
entries.text:
## shout

**音标**：/ʃaʊt/

**释义**：vt.&vi. 大声说；叫；嚷；斥责；怒骂；n. 喊叫声；v./n. 呼喊,呼叫

**例句**：The coach shouted instructions from the sidelines, but the noisy crowd made it hard for players to hear.

教练在场边大声喊出指令，但喧闹的人群让队员们很难听清。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shove
entries.text:
## shove

**音标**：/ʃʌv/

**释义**：n. [口]推,挤；vt. [口]推挤,猛推；乱放,乱塞；v. 猛推；乱放

**搭配**
- give sb./sth. a good shove：猛推某人/某物

**例句**：Passengers began to shove their way onto the crowded train, ignoring the staff's repeated warnings.

乘客们开始推挤着挤上拥挤的火车，无视工作人员的一再警告。

**提示**：索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shovel
entries.text:
## shovel

**音标**：/ˈʃɒvl/

**释义**：n. 铲子；铁锹；v. 铲；铲起

**例句**：Workers used a shovel to clear the snow from the platform before the morning trains arrived.

工人们在早班列车到达之前用铁铲清除站台上的积雪。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: show
entries.text:
## show

**音标**：/ʃəʊ/

**释义**：v. 展示；表明；n. [C] 展览；节目；vt. 显示；表明；vt. 呈现,显示;表明,证明；n. 展览,展览会,演出；vt. 表明；（图画、图表、文章等）表示；表现；显示出（品质、特征）；展示

**搭配**
- show off：炫耀
- on show：在展出
- show up：显而易见;出席,到场

**例句**：Employers must both show cause and act in a procedurally fair way.

雇主既要说明原因，又要按公正的程序办事。

**提示**：辨析：show 最普通的用词，泛指任何有意或无意地把东西给别人看的行为；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shower
entries.text:
## shower

**音标**：/ˈʃaʊə(r)/

**释义**：n. [C] 淋浴；阵雨；n. [C] 阵雨；淋浴；vi. 下降雨；n. 阵雨,阵雨般的东西;一大批,一大串；n. 淋浴,淋浴器,淋浴间；v. 下降雨;阵雨般落下

**搭配**
- take a shower：淋浴

**例句**：The weather forecast warns that a heavy shower will sweep across the region tomorrow afternoon.

天气预报警告说，明天下午一场阵雨将席卷该地区。

**提示**：be caught in a shower 遇到一阵大暴雨;a shower of 一大批

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shrewd
entries.text:
## shrewd

**音标**：/ʃruːd/

**释义**：adj. 精明的；机灵的；adj. 精明的；adj. 机灵的,敏锐的,精明的；adj. 精明的；敏锐的；有眼光的；判断得准的；adj. 精明的；敏锐的

**例句**：Paul was too shrewd to be taken in by this argument.

保罗太精明了，不会被这场争论所欺骗。

**提示**：24 谐音记忆更牢固呦；发音类似"熟的"→熟悉这个事物的人，看待它一般比较"敏锐"→敏锐的；索引p416

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shrimp
entries.text:
## shrimp

**音标**：/ʃrɪmp/

**释义**：n. 虾，小虾

**例句**：The coastal economy depends heavily on shrimp farming, which now employs thousands of local families.

沿海经济严重依赖养虾业，该行业如今雇用了数千户当地家庭。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shrink
entries.text:
## shrink

**音标**：/ʃrɪŋk/

**释义**：vi. 收缩，缩小；退缩；vi. 收缩；缩小；vi. 畏缩；退缩；v. (使)起皱,收缩,缩水；v. (使)(数量、体积或价值)减少,缩小；v. (尤指因恐惧而)畏缩,退缩; n. 精神病学家

**搭配**
- shrink from doing sth.：不愿做某事
- shrink from doing sth：不愿做某事
- a shrinking market：萎缩的市场
- shrink from sth.：回避(困难等)

**例句**：The market for their products is shrinking.

市场对他们产品的需求在减少。

**提示**：v.缩小，减少；缩水；退缩，畏 缩 n.心理学家；shr(联想share分享)+ink(墨水)→分享墨水给别人

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: shroud
entries.text:
## shroud

**音标**：/ʃraʊd/

**释义**：n. 寿衣,裹尸布;覆盖物;遮蔽物；v. 遮蔽;覆盖;隐藏

**例句**：Thick fog shrouded the valley all morning, making the rescue operation far more difficult.

entries.subject: english2

entries.subject: english2

entries.subject: english2

entries.subject: english2

这位老兵很少谈及那场战争，即使孙辈们直接问他也不说。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sole
entries.text:
## sole

她是这家餐馆的唯一所有者。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: solely
entries.text:

**释义**：ad. 仅；只；唯一地

**例句**：The committee stressed that the final decision was based solely on scientific evidence, not political pressure.

委员会强调，最终决定完全基于科学证据，而非政治压力。

**提示**：sole（唯一的）+ly→唯一地。近义：only ad. 仅仅；adv.单独地，仅有地

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: solemn
entries.text:
## solemn

**音标**：/'sɔləm/

**释义**：adj. 庄严的,隆重的,严肃的

**例句**：The ceremony ended with a solemn promise that the disaster's victims would never be forgotten.

仪式在庄严的承诺中结束：灾难的遇难者永远不会被遗忘。

**提示**：派生solemnly庄严地,隆重地;solemnness庄严,隆重

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: solicitor
entries.text:
## solicitor

**音标**：/səˈlɪsɪtə(r)/

**释义**：n. 律师；恳求者

**例句**：Consult a solicitor before signing any contract that involves property or long-term financial commitments.

签署任何涉及房产或长期财务承诺的合同之前，先咨询事务律师。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: solid
entries.text:

**音标**：/ˈsɒlɪd/

**搭配**
- solid evidence：确凿的证据
- a solid foundation：坚实的基础

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: solidarity
entries.text:
## solidarity

**音标**：/ˌsɒlɪ'dærəti/

**释义**：n. 团结一致,共同责任,休戚相关；n. 团结

- reinforce social solidarity：加强社会团结

全国工人对罢工矿工表示声援。

**提示**：n.团结一致；索引p417

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: solitary
entries.text:
## solitary

**音标**：/ˈsɒlətri/

**释义**：a. 独自的；单独的；孤独的；adj. 孤独的

**搭配**
- a solitary existence：独居生活

这位作家在山里过着独居生活，很少接待访客或离开他的小屋。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: solo
entries.text:
## solo

**音标**：/ˈsəʊləʊ/

**释义**：adj./adv. 单独的（地）；n. 独奏，独唱；a. 独自的；独奏的；n. [C] 独奏；独唱；独舞；n. 独奏曲；adj. 单独的

这位年轻的钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一段精彩的独奏。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: soluble
entries.text:
## soluble

**音标**：/ˈsɔljəbl/

**释义**：adj. 可溶的

该化学品可溶于水但不溶于油，这使得分离相对容易。

**提示**：派生 solubility n. 可溶性，溶解度

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: solut
entries.text:
## solut

**音标**：/səˈluːt/

**释义**：解开

**例句**：Words such as solution and absolute contain the root solut, which means to loosen or untie.

solution 和 absolute 等词都包含意为“解开、松开”的词根 solut。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: solution
entries.text:
## solution

**音标**：/səˈluːʃn/

**释义**：n. [C] 解决办法；n. [C][U] 溶液；n. ①解答，解决办法(c/u)；②溶液，溶解；n. 解答，解决办法；n. 解决办法

**例句**：The solution is to change the mindset of the academic community, and what it considers to be its main goal.

解决办法是改变学术界的心态，及学术界对其主要目标的认识。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: solv
entries.text:
## solv

**音标**：/sɒlv/

由于词根 solv 意为“解开、溶解”，它出现在 solve、dissolve 和 solvent 中。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: solv solut
entries.text:
## solv solut

**音标**：/sɒlv/

**释义**：解开

**例句**：Solve, solution and dissolve all trace back to the same root, solv or solut, whose basic sense is to loosen.

solve、solution 和 dissolve 都可追溯到同一词根 solv 或 solut，其基本含义是“松开”。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: solvable
entries.text:
## solvable

**音标**：/ˈsɒlvəbl/

**释义**：adj. 可解决的

工程师仍然确信这些技术问题在给定预算内完全可以解决。

**提示**：adj.可以解决的；索引p417

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: solve
entries.text:

**音标**：/sɒlv/

**搭配**
- solve the problem：解决问题

**例句**：Attempts are being made to solve the problem of waste disposal.

正在想办法解决废物处理的问题。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: some

展出的绘画中有一些以前从未向公众展示过。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: somebody
entries.text:
## somebody

**音标**：/'sʌmbədi/

**释义**：pron. 某人，有人

**例句**：Somebody must take responsibility for the accounting error before the annual report is published.

在年报发布之前，必须有人为这次账目错误承担责任。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: somehow
entries.text:

**释义**：ad. 以某种方式；不知怎么地

**搭配**

那座古桥竟然在洪水中幸存下来，而山谷里几乎其他所有建筑都被毁坏了。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: someone
entries.text:

**音标**：/'sʌmwʌn/

有人在办公室门口留下一个神秘包裹，警察被叫来检查。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: something

**释义**：pron. 某事；某物；ad. 很，非常

**例句**：There is something strange about the data, and the researchers decided to repeat the experiment.

这些数据有些异常，研究人员决定重做这个实验。

entries.title: sometime
entries.text:

**音标**：/ˈsʌmtaɪm/

新博物馆预计明年春天某个时候开放，但确切日期尚未确定。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: sometimes

即使是经验丰富的司机，在道路被冰雪覆盖时有时也会出错。

entries.subject: english2
entries.title: somewhat

这一发现有些出人意料，因为早先的研究得出了几乎相反的结论。

entries.title: somewhere

那份手稿被遗忘在图书馆地下室的某个角落，长达近一个世纪。

钢琴家为音乐会下半场选择了贝多芬晚期的一首奏鸣曲。

entries.subject: english2

entries.subject: english2

entries.text:
